A suite in a hotel or other public accommodation, denotes a class of luxury accommodations, the key feature of which is multiple rooms (source: Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia, see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suite_(hotel)).

See also the dedicated document on the use of schema.org for marking up hotels and other forms of accommodations.

classes.label: SuperficialAnatomy
classes.definition: Anatomical features that can be observed by sight (without dissection), including the form and proportions of the human body as well as surface landmarks that correspond to deeper subcutaneous structures. Superficial anatomy plays an important role in sports medicine, phlebotomy, and other medical specialties as underlying anatomical structures can be identified through surface palpation. For example, during back surgery, superficial anatomy can be used to palpate and count vertebrae to find the site of incision. Or in phlebotomy, superficial anatomy can be used to locate an underlying vein; for example, the median cubital vein can be located by palpating the borders of the cubital fossa (such as the epicondyles of the humerus) and then looking for the superficial signs of the vein, such as size, prominence, ability to refill after depression, and feel of surrounding tissue support. As another example, in a subluxation (dislocation) of the glenohumeral joint, the bony structure becomes pronounced with the deltoid muscle failing to cover the glenohumeral joint allowing the edges of the scapula to be superficially visible. Here, the superficial anatomy is the visible edges of the scapula, implying the underlying dislocation of the joint (the related anatomical structure).

classes.label: SurgicalProcedure
classes.definition: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed for diagnose, or therapeutic purposes.

classes.label: SuspendAction
classes.definition: The act of momentarily pausing a device or application (e.g. pause music playback or pause a timer).

classes.label: Syllabus
classes.definition: A syllabus that describes the material covered in a course, often with several such sections per [[Course]] so that a distinct [[timeRequired]] can be provided for that section of the [[Course]].

classes.label: Synagogue
classes.definition: A synagogue.

classes.label: TVClip
classes.definition: A short TV program or a segment/part of a TV program.

classes.label: TVEpisode
classes.definition: A TV episode which can be part of a series or season.

classes.label: TVSeason
classes.definition: Season dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

classes.label: TVSeries
classes.definition: CreativeWorkSeries dedicated to TV broadcast and associated online delivery.

classes.label: Table
classes.definition: A table on a Web page.

classes.label: TakeAction
classes.definition:
The act of gaining ownership of an object from an origin. Reciprocal of GiveAction.

Related actions:

* [[GiveAction]]: The reciprocal of TakeAction.
* [[ReceiveAction]]: Unlike ReceiveAction, TakeAction implies that ownership has been transferred.

classes.label: TattooParlor
classes.definition: A tattoo parlor.

classes.label: Taxi
classes.definition: A taxi.

classes.label: TaxiReservation
classes.definition: A reservation for a taxi.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

classes.label: TaxiService
classes.definition: A service for a vehicle for hire with a driver for local travel. Fares are usually calculated based on distance traveled.

classes.label: TaxiStand
classes.definition: A taxi stand.

classes.label: Taxon
classes.definition: A set of organisms asserted to represent a natural cohesive biological unit.

classes.label: TechArticle
classes.definition: A technical article - Example: How-to (task) topics, step-by-step, procedural troubleshooting, specifications, etc.

classes.label: TelevisionChannel
classes.definition: A unique instance of a television BroadcastService on a CableOrSatelliteService lineup.

classes.label: TelevisionStation
classes.definition: A television station.

classes.label: TennisComplex
classes.definition: A tennis complex.

classes.label: Text
classes.definition: Data type: Text.

classes.label: TextDigitalDocument
classes.definition: A file composed primarily of text.

classes.label: TextObject
classes.definition: A text file. The text can be unformatted or contain markup, html, etc.

classes.label: TheaterEvent
classes.definition: Event type: Theater performance.

classes.label: TheaterGroup
classes.definition: A theater group or company, for example, the Royal Shakespeare Company or Druid Theatre.

classes.label: TherapeuticProcedure
classes.definition: A medical procedure intended primarily for therapeutic purposes, aimed at improving a health condition.

classes.label: Thesis
classes.definition: A thesis or dissertation document submitted in support of candidature for an academic degree or professional qualification.

classes.label: Thing
classes.definition: The most generic type of item.

classes.label: Ticket
classes.definition: Used to describe a ticket to an event, a flight, a bus ride, etc.

classes.label: TieAction
classes.definition: The act of reaching a draw in a competitive activity.

classes.label: TierBenefitEnumeration
classes.definition: An enumeration of possible benefits as part of a loyalty (members) program.

classes.label: Time
classes.definition: A point in time recurring on multiple days in the form hh:mm:ss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] (see [XML schema for details](http://www.w3.org/TR/xmlschema-2/#time)).

classes.label: TipAction
classes.definition: The act of giving money voluntarily to a beneficiary in recognition of services rendered.

classes.label: TireShop
classes.definition: A tire shop.

classes.label: TouristAttraction
classes.definition: A tourist attraction. In principle any Thing can be a [[TouristAttraction]], from a [[Mountain]] and [[LandmarksOrHistoricalBuildings]] to a [[LocalBusiness]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristAttraction]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist attraction properties to any other type. (See examples below)

classes.label: TouristDestination
classes.definition: A tourist destination. In principle any [[Place]] can be a [[TouristDestination]] from a [[City]], Region or [[Country]] to an [[AmusementPark]] or [[Hotel]]. This Type can be used on its own to describe a general [[TouristDestination]], or be used as an [[additionalType]] to add tourist relevant properties to any other [[Place]]. A [[TouristDestination]] is defined as a [[Place]] that contains, or is colocated with, one or more [[TouristAttraction]]s, often linked by a similar theme or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines Destination (main destination of a tourism trip) as the place visited that is central to the decision to take the trip. (See examples below.)

classes.label: TouristInformationCenter
classes.definition: A tourist information center.

classes.label: TouristTrip
classes.definition: A tourist trip. A created itinerary of visits to one or more places of interest ([[TouristAttraction]]/[[TouristDestination]]) often linked by a similar theme, geographic area, or interest to a particular [[touristType]]. The [UNWTO](http://www2.unwto.org/) defines tourism trip as the Trip taken by visitors. (See examples below.)

classes.label: ToyStore
classes.definition: A toy store.

classes.label: TrackAction
classes.definition:
An agent tracks an object for updates.

Related actions:

* [[FollowAction]]: Unlike FollowAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimates objects.
* [[SubscribeAction]]: Unlike SubscribeAction, TrackAction refers to the interest on the location of innanimate objects.

classes.label: TradeAction
classes.definition: The act of participating in an exchange of goods and services for monetary compensation. An agent trades an object, product or service with a participant in exchange for a one time or periodic payment.

classes.label: TrainReservation
classes.definition: A reservation for train travel.\n\nNote: This type is for information about actual reservations, e.g. in confirmation emails or HTML pages with individual confirmations of reservations. For offers of tickets, use [[Offer]].

classes.label: TrainStation
classes.definition: A train station.

classes.label: TrainTrip
classes.definition: A trip on a commercial train line.

classes.label: TransferAction
classes.definition: The act of transferring/moving (abstract or concrete) animate or inanimate objects from one place to another.

classes.label: TravelAction
classes.definition: The act of traveling from a fromLocation to a destination by a specified mode of transport, optionally with participants.

classes.label: TravelAgency
classes.definition: A travel agency.

classes.label: TreatmentIndication
classes.definition: An indication for treating an underlying condition, symptom, etc.

classes.label: Trip
classes.definition: A trip or journey. An itinerary of visits to one or more places.

classes.label: TypeAndQuantityNode
classes.definition: A structured value indicating the quantity, unit of measurement, and business function of goods included in a bundle offer.

classes.label: UKNonprofitType

classes.label: URL

classes.label: USNonprofitType

The act of un-registering from a service.

Related actions:

* [[RegisterAction]]: antonym of UnRegisterAction.
* [[LeaveAction]]: Unlike LeaveAction, UnRegisterAction implies that you are unregistering from a service you were previously registered, rather than leaving a team/group of people.

classes.label: UnitPriceSpecification
classes.definition: The price asked for a given offer by the respective organization or person.

classes.label: VacationRental
classes.definition: A kind of lodging business that focuses on renting single properties for limited time.

classes.label: Vehicle
classes.definition: A vehicle is a device that is designed or used to transport people or cargo over land, water, air, or through space.

classes.label: Vein
classes.definition: A type of blood vessel that specifically carries blood to the heart.

classes.label: Vessel
classes.definition: A component of the human body circulatory system comprised of an intricate network of hollow tubes that transport blood throughout the entire body.

classes.label: VeterinaryCare
classes.definition: A vet's office.

classes.label: VideoGallery
classes.definition: Web page type: Video gallery page.

classes.label: VideoGame
classes.definition: A video game is an electronic game that involves human interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.

classes.label: VideoGameClip
classes.definition: A short segment/part of a video game.

classes.label: VideoGameSeries
classes.definition: A video game series.

classes.label: VideoObject
classes.definition: A video file.

classes.label: VideoObjectSnapshot
classes.definition: A specific and exact (byte-for-byte) version of a [[VideoObject]]. Two byte-for-byte identical files, for the purposes of this type, considered identical. If they have different embedded metadata the files will differ. Different external facts about the files, e.g. creator or dateCreated that aren't represented in their actual content, do not affect this notion of identity.

classes.label: ViewAction
classes.definition: The act of consuming static visual content.

classes.label: VirtualLocation
classes.definition: An online or virtual location for attending events. For example, one may attend an online seminar or educational event. While a virtual location may be used as the location of an event, virtual locations should not be confused with physical locations in the real world.

classes.label: VisualArtsEvent
classes.definition: Event type: Visual arts event.

classes.label: VisualArtwork
classes.definition: A work of art that is primarily visual in character.

classes.label: VitalSign
classes.definition: Vital signs are measures of various physiological functions in order to assess the most basic body functions.

classes.label: Volcano
classes.definition: A volcano, like Fujisan.

classes.label: VoteAction
classes.definition: The act of expressing a preference from a fixed/finite/structured set of choices/options.

classes.label: WPAdBlock
classes.definition: An advertising section of the page.

classes.label: WPFooter
classes.definition: The footer section of the page.

classes.label: WPHeader
classes.definition: The header section of the page.

classes.label: WPSideBar
classes.definition: A sidebar section of the page.

classes.label: WantAction
classes.definition: The act of expressing a desire about the object. An agent wants an object.

classes.label: WarrantyPromise
classes.definition: A structured value representing the duration and scope of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

classes.label: WarrantyScope
classes.definition:
A range of services that will be provided to a customer free of charge in case of a defect or malfunction of a product.

Commonly used values:

* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Labor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-BringIn
* http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#PartsAndLabor-PickUp

classes.label: WatchAction
classes.definition: The act of consuming dynamic/moving visual content.

classes.label: Waterfall
classes.definition: A waterfall, like Niagara.

classes.label: WearAction
classes.definition: The act of dressing oneself in clothing.

classes.label: WearableMeasurementTypeEnumeration
classes.definition: Enumerates common types of measurement for wearables products.

classes.label: WearableSizeGroupEnumeration
classes.definition: Enumerates common size groups (also known as "size types") for wearable products.

classes.label: WearableSizeSystemEnumeration
classes.definition: Enumerates common size systems specific for wearable products.

classes.label: WebAPI
classes.definition: An application programming interface accessible over Web/Internet technologies.

classes.label: WebApplication
classes.definition: Web applications.

classes.label: WebContent
classes.definition: WebContent is a type representing all [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] content. It is sometimes the case that detailed distinctions between Web pages, sites and their parts are not always important or obvious. The [[WebContent]] type makes it easier to describe Web-addressable content without requiring such distinctions to always be stated. (The intent is that the existing types [[WebPage]], [[WebSite]] and [[WebPageElement]] will eventually be declared as subtypes of [[WebContent]].)

classes.label: WebPage
classes.definition: A web page. Every web page is implicitly assumed to be declared to be of type WebPage, so the various properties about that webpage, such as breadcrumb may be used. We recommend explicit declaration if these properties are specified, but if they are found outside of an itemscope, they will be assumed to be about the page.

classes.label: WebPageElement
classes.definition: A web page element, like a table or an image.

classes.label: WebSite
classes.definition: A WebSite is a set of related web pages and other items typically served from a single web domain and accessible via URLs.

classes.label: WholesaleStore
classes.definition: A wholesale store.

classes.label: WinAction
classes.definition: The act of achieving victory in a competitive activity.

classes.label: Winery
classes.definition: A winery.

classes.label: WorkBasedProgram
classes.definition: A program with both an educational and employment component. Typically based at a workplace and structured around work-based learning, with the aim of instilling competencies related to an occupation. WorkBasedProgram is used to distinguish programs such as apprenticeships from school, college or other classroom based educational programs.

classes.label: WorkersUnion
classes.definition: A Workers Union (also known as a Labor Union, Labour Union, or Trade Union) is an organization that promotes the interests of its worker members by collectively bargaining with management, organizing, and political lobbying.

classes.label: WriteAction
classes.definition: The act of authoring written creative content.

classes.label: XPathType
classes.definition: Text representing an XPath (typically but not necessarily version 1.0).

classes.label: Zoo
classes.definition: A zoo.

properties.label: about
properties.definition: The subject matter of an object.

properties.label: accelerationTime
properties.definition:
The time needed to accelerate the vehicle from a given start velocity to a given target velocity.

Typical unit code(s): SEC for seconds

* Note: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for seconds/0..100 km/h or seconds/0..60 mph. Simply use "SEC" for seconds and indicate the velocities in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]], or use [[valueReference]] with a [[QuantitativeValue]] of 0..60 mph or 0..100 km/h to specify the reference speeds.

properties.label: acceptedAnswer
properties.definition: The answer(s) that has been accepted as best, typically on a Question/Answer site. Sites vary in their selection mechanisms, e.g. drawing on community opinion and/or the view of the Question author.

properties.label: acceptedOffer
properties.definition: The offer(s) -- e.g., product, quantity and price combinations -- included in the order.

properties.label: acceptedPaymentMethod
properties.definition: The payment method(s) that are accepted in general by an organization, or for some specific demand or offer.

properties.label: accessModeSufficient
properties.definition: A list of single or combined access modes that are sufficient to understand all the intellectual content of a resource, including any adaptations. Values should be drawn from the [approved vocabulary](https://www.w3.org/2021/a11y-discov-vocab/latest/#accessModeSufficient-vocabulary).

properties.label: accommodationFloorPlan
properties.definition: A floorplan of some [[Accommodation]].

properties.label: accountMinimumInflow
properties.definition: A minimum amount that has to be paid in every month.

properties.label: accountOverdraftLimit
properties.definition: An overdraft is an extension of credit from a lending institution when an account reaches zero. An overdraft allows the individual to continue withdrawing money even if the account has no funds in it. Basically the bank allows people to borrow a set amount of money.

properties.label: accountablePerson
properties.definition: Specifies the Person that is legally accountable for the CreativeWork.

properties.label: acquireLicensePage
properties.definition: Indicates a page documenting how licenses can be purchased or otherwise acquired, for the current item.

properties.label: acquiredFrom
properties.definition: The organization or person from which the product was acquired.

properties.label: actionAccessibilityRequirement
properties.definition: A set of requirements that must be fulfilled in order to perform an Action. If more than one value is specified, fulfilling one set of requirements will allow the Action to be performed.

properties.label: actionApplication
properties.definition: An application that can complete the request.

properties.label: actionOption
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

properties.label: actionPlatform
properties.definition: The high level platform(s) where the Action can be performed for the given URL. To specify a specific application or operating system instance, use actionApplication.

properties.label: actionProcess
properties.definition: Description of the process by which the action was performed.

properties.label: actionStatus
properties.definition: Indicates the current disposition of the Action.

properties.label: actionableFeedbackPolicy
properties.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement about public engagement activities (for news media, the newsroom’s), including involving the public - digitally or otherwise -- in coverage decisions, reporting and activities after publication.

properties.label: activityDuration
properties.definition: Length of time to engage in the activity.

properties.label: activityFrequency
properties.definition: How often one should engage in the activity.

properties.label: actor
properties.definition: An actor (individual or a group), e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc., or in an event. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

properties.label: actors
properties.definition: An actor, e.g. in TV, radio, movie, video games etc. Actors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

properties.label: addOn
properties.definition: An additional offer that can only be obtained in combination with the first base offer (e.g. supplements and extensions that are available for a surcharge).

properties.label: additionalProperty
properties.definition: A property-value pair representing an additional characteristic of the entity, e.g. a product feature or another characteristic for which there is no matching property in schema.org.\n\nNote: Publishers should be aware that applications designed to use specific schema.org properties (e.g. https://schema.org/width, https://schema.org/color, https://schema.org/gtin13, ...) will typically expect such data to be provided using those properties, rather than using the generic property/value mechanism.

properties.label: address
properties.definition: Physical address of the item.

properties.label: addressCountry
properties.definition: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1) format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-3) country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

properties.label: addressRegion
properties.definition: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. For example, California or another appropriate first-level [Administrative division](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_administrative_divisions_by_country) such as the Province in Italy or Region in Germany.

properties.label: advanceBookingRequirement
properties.definition: The amount of time that is required between accepting the offer and the actual usage of the resource or service.

properties.label: adverseOutcome
properties.definition: A possible complication and/or side effect of this therapy. If it is known that an adverse outcome is serious (resulting in death, disability, or permanent damage; requiring hospitalization; or otherwise life-threatening or requiring immediate medical attention), tag it as a seriousAdverseOutcome instead.

properties.label: affectedBy
properties.definition: Drugs that affect the test's results.

properties.label: affiliation
properties.definition: An organization that this person is affiliated with. For example, a school/university, a club, or a team.

properties.label: afterMedia
properties.definition: A media object representing the circumstances after performing this direction.

properties.label: agent
properties.definition: The direct performer or driver of the action (animate or inanimate). E.g. *John* wrote a book.

properties.label: agentInteractionStatistic
properties.definition: The number of completed interactions for this entity, in a particular role (the 'agent'), in a particular action (indicated in the statistic), and in a particular context (i.e. interactionService).

properties.label: aggregateElement
properties.definition: Indicates a prototype of the elements in the list that is used to hold aggregate information (ratings, offers, etc.).

properties.label: aggregateRating
properties.definition: The overall rating, based on a collection of reviews or ratings, of the item.

properties.label: aircraft
properties.definition: The kind of aircraft (e.g., "Boeing 747").

properties.label: album
properties.definition: A music album.

properties.label: albumProductionType
properties.definition: Classification of the album by its type of content: soundtrack, live album, studio album, etc.

properties.label: albumRelease
properties.definition: A release of this album.

properties.label: albumReleaseType
properties.definition: The kind of release which this album is: single, EP or album.

properties.label: albums
properties.definition: A collection of music albums.

properties.label: alternativeOf
properties.definition: Another gene which is a variation of this one.

properties.label: alumni
properties.definition: Alumni of an organization.

properties.label: alumniOf
properties.definition: An organization that the person is an alumni of.

properties.label: amenityFeature
properties.definition: An amenity feature (e.g. a characteristic or service) of the Accommodation. This generic property does not make a statement about whether the feature is included in an offer for the main accommodation or available at extra costs.

properties.label: amount
properties.definition: The amount of money.

properties.label: announcementLocation
properties.definition: Indicates a specific [[CivicStructure]] or [[LocalBusiness]] associated with the SpecialAnnouncement. For example, a specific testing facility or business with special opening hours. For a larger geographic region like a quarantine of an entire region, use [[spatialCoverage]].

properties.label: annualPercentageRate
properties.definition: The annual rate that is charged for borrowing (or made by investing), expressed as a single percentage number that represents the actual yearly cost of funds over the term of a loan. This includes any fees or additional costs associated with the transaction.

properties.label: answerExplanation
properties.definition: A step-by-step or full explanation about Answer. Can outline how this Answer was achieved or contain more broad clarification or statement about it.

properties.label: antagonist
properties.definition: The muscle whose action counteracts the specified muscle.

properties.label: appearance
properties.definition: Indicates an occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

properties.label: applicableCountry
properties.definition: A country where a particular merchant return policy applies to, for example the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

properties.label: applicableLocation
properties.definition: The location in which the status applies.

properties.label: applicantLocationRequirements
properties.definition: The location(s) applicants can apply from. This is usually used for telecommuting jobs where the applicant does not need to be in a physical office. Note: This should not be used for citizenship or work visa requirements.

properties.label: application
properties.definition: An application that can complete the request.

properties.label: applicationContact
properties.definition: Contact details for further information relevant to this job posting.

properties.label: appliesToDeliveryMethod
properties.definition: The delivery method(s) to which the delivery charge or payment charge specification applies.

properties.label: appliesToPaymentMethod
properties.definition: The payment method(s) to which the payment charge specification applies.

properties.label: archiveHeld
properties.definition: Collection, [fonds](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fonds), or item held, kept or maintained by an [[ArchiveOrganization]].

properties.label: archivedAt
properties.definition: Indicates a page or other link involved in archival of a [[CreativeWork]]. In the case of [[MediaReview]], the items in a [[MediaReviewItem]] may often become inaccessible, but be archived by archival, journalistic, activist, or law enforcement organizations. In such cases, the referenced page may not directly publish the content.

properties.label: area
properties.definition: The area within which users can expect to reach the broadcast service.

properties.label: areaServed
properties.definition: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.

properties.label: arrivalAirport
properties.definition: The airport where the flight terminates.

properties.label: arrivalBoatTerminal
properties.definition: The terminal or port from which the boat arrives.

properties.label: arrivalBusStop
properties.definition: The stop or station from which the bus arrives.

properties.label: arrivalStation
properties.definition: The station where the train trip ends.

properties.label: arterialBranch
properties.definition: The branches that comprise the arterial structure.

properties.label: artist
properties.definition: The primary artist for a work in a medium other than pencils or digital line art--for example, if the primary artwork is done in watercolors or digital paints.

properties.label: assesses
properties.definition: The item being described is intended to assess the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

properties.label: associatedAnatomy
properties.definition: The anatomy of the underlying organ system or structures associated with this entity.

properties.label: associatedArticle
properties.definition: A NewsArticle associated with the Media Object.

properties.label: associatedClaimReview
properties.definition: An associated [[ClaimReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

properties.label: associatedDisease
properties.definition: Disease associated to this BioChemEntity. Such disease can be a MedicalCondition or a URL. If you want to add an evidence supporting the association, please use PropertyValue.

properties.label: associatedMedia
properties.definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for encoding.

properties.label: associatedMediaReview
properties.definition: An associated [[MediaReview]], related by specific common content, topic or claim. The expectation is that this property would be most typically used in cases where a single activity is conducting both claim reviews and media reviews, in which case [[relatedMediaReview]] would commonly be used on a [[ClaimReview]], while [[associatedClaimReview]] would be used on [[MediaReview]].

properties.label: associatedReview
properties.definition: An associated [[Review]].

properties.label: athlete
properties.definition: A person that acts as performing member of a sports team; a player as opposed to a coach.

properties.label: attendee
properties.definition: A person or organization attending the event.

properties.label: attendees
properties.definition: A person attending the event.

properties.label: audience
properties.definition: An intended audience, i.e. a group for whom something was created.

properties.label: audio
properties.definition: An embedded audio object.

properties.label: authenticator
properties.definition: The Organization responsible for authenticating the user's subscription. For example, many media apps require a cable/satellite provider to authenticate your subscription before playing media.

properties.label: author
properties.definition: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

properties.label: availability
properties.definition: The availability of this item—for example In stock, Out of stock, Pre-order, etc.

properties.label: availableAtOrFrom
properties.definition: The place(s) from which the offer can be obtained (e.g. store locations).

properties.label: availableChannel
properties.definition: A means of accessing the service (e.g. a phone bank, a web site, a location, etc.).

properties.label: availableDeliveryMethod
properties.definition: The delivery method(s) available for this offer.

properties.label: availableIn
properties.definition: The location in which the strength is available.

properties.label: availableLanguage
properties.definition: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].

properties.label: availableService
properties.definition: A medical service available from this provider.

properties.label: availableStrength
properties.definition: An available dosage strength for the drug.

properties.label: availableTest
properties.definition: A diagnostic test or procedure offered by this lab.

properties.label: awayTeam
properties.definition: The away team in a sports event.

properties.label: backstory
properties.definition: For an [[Article]], typically a [[NewsArticle]], the backstory property provides a textual summary giving a brief explanation of why and how an article was created. In a journalistic setting this could include information about reporting process, methods, interviews, data sources, etc.

properties.label: baseSalary
properties.definition: The base salary of the job or of an employee in an EmployeeRole.

properties.label: bccRecipient
properties.definition: A sub property of recipient. The recipient blind copied on a message.

properties.label: bed
properties.definition: The type of bed or beds included in the accommodation. For the single case of just one bed of a certain type, you use bed directly with a text. If you want to indicate the quantity of a certain kind of bed, use an instance of BedDetails. For more detailed information, use the amenityFeature property.

properties.label: beforeMedia
properties.definition: A media object representing the circumstances before performing this direction.

properties.label: beneficiaryBank
properties.definition: A bank or bank’s branch, financial institution or international financial institution operating the beneficiary’s bank account or releasing funds for the beneficiary.

properties.label: billingAddress
properties.definition: The billing address for the order.

properties.label: billingDuration
properties.definition: Specifies for how long this price (or price component) will be billed. Can be used, for example, to model the contractual duration of a subscription or payment plan. Type can be either a Duration or a Number (in which case the unit of measurement, for example month, is specified by the unitCode property).

properties.label: billingPeriod
properties.definition: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

properties.label: bioChemInteraction
properties.definition: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

properties.label: bioChemSimilarity
properties.definition: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

properties.label: biologicalRole
properties.definition: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

properties.label: birthPlace
properties.definition: The place where the person was born.

properties.label: blogPost
properties.definition: A posting that is part of this blog.

properties.label: blogPosts
properties.definition: Indicates a post that is part of a [[Blog]]. Note that historically, what we term a "Blog" was once known as a "weblog", and that what we term a "BlogPosting" is now often colloquially referred to as a "blog".

properties.label: bloodSupply
properties.definition: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.

properties.label: boardingPolicy
properties.definition: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).

properties.label: bodyType
properties.definition: Indicates the design and body style of the vehicle (e.g. station wagon, hatchback, etc.).

properties.label: bookFormat
properties.definition: The format of the book.

properties.label: bookingAgent
properties.definition: 'bookingAgent' is an out-dated term indicating a 'broker' that serves as a booking agent.

properties.label: borrower
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The person that borrows the object being lent.

properties.label: branch
properties.definition: The branches that delineate from the nerve bundle. Not to be confused with [[branchOf]].

properties.label: branchOf
properties.definition: The larger organization that this local business is a branch of, if any. Not to be confused with (anatomical) [[branch]].

properties.label: brand
properties.definition: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

properties.label: breadcrumb
properties.definition: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

properties.label: broadcastAffiliateOf
properties.definition: The media network(s) whose content is broadcast on this station.

properties.label: broadcastFrequency
properties.definition: The frequency used for over-the-air broadcasts. Numeric values or simple ranges, e.g. 87-99. In addition a shortcut idiom is supported for frequencies of AM and FM radio channels, e.g. "87 FM".

properties.label: broadcastFrequencyValue
properties.definition: The frequency in MHz for a particular broadcast.

properties.label: broadcastOfEvent
properties.definition: The event being broadcast such as a sporting event or awards ceremony.

properties.label: broadcastSignalModulation
properties.definition: The modulation (e.g. FM, AM, etc) used by a particular broadcast service.

properties.label: broadcaster
properties.definition: The organization owning or operating the broadcast service.

properties.label: broker
properties.definition: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller. In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange. If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

properties.label: businessDays
properties.definition: Days of the week when the merchant typically operates, indicated via opening hours markup.

properties.label: businessFunction
properties.definition: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

properties.label: buyer
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The participant/person/organization that bought the object.

properties.label: byArtist
properties.definition: The artist that performed this album or recording.

properties.label: byDay
properties.definition: Defines the day(s) of the week on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. May be specified using either [[DayOfWeek]], or alternatively [[Text]] conforming to iCal's syntax for byDay recurrence rules.

properties.label: calories
properties.definition: The number of calories.

properties.label: candidate
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The candidate subject of this action.

properties.label: caption
properties.definition: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

properties.label: carbohydrateContent
properties.definition: The number of grams of carbohydrates.

properties.label: cargoVolume
properties.definition:
The available volume for cargo or luggage. For automobiles, this is usually the trunk volume.

Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet

Note: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

properties.label: carrier
properties.definition: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.

properties.label: catalog
properties.definition: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

properties.label: category
properties.definition: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

properties.label: cause
properties.definition: The cause of a medical condition.

properties.label: causeOf
properties.definition: The condition, complication, symptom, sign, etc. caused.

properties.label: ccRecipient
properties.definition: A sub property of recipient. The recipient copied on a message.

properties.label: certificationIdentification
properties.definition: Identifier of a certification instance (as registered with an independent certification body). Typically this identifier can be used to consult and verify the certification instance. See also [gs1:certificationIdentification](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationIdentification).

properties.label: certificationRating
properties.definition: Rating of a certification instance (as defined by an independent certification body). Typically this rating can be used to rate the level to which the requirements of the certification instance are fulfilled. See also [gs1:certificationValue](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationValue).

properties.label: certificationStatus
properties.definition: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

properties.label: character
properties.definition: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

properties.label: characterAttribute
properties.definition: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

properties.label: cheatCode
properties.definition: Cheat codes to the game.

properties.label: chemicalRole
properties.definition: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.

properties.label: childTaxon
properties.definition: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.

properties.label: children
properties.definition: A child of the person.

properties.label: cholesterolContent
properties.definition: The number of milligrams of cholesterol.

properties.label: citation
properties.definition: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

properties.label: claimInterpreter
properties.definition: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].

properties.label: coach
properties.definition: A person that acts in a coaching role for a sports team.

properties.label: code
properties.definition: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

properties.label: colleague
properties.definition: A colleague of the person.

properties.label: colleagues
properties.definition: A colleague of the person.

properties.label: collection
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

properties.label: colorSwatch
properties.definition: A color swatch image, visualizing the color of a [[Product]]. Should match the textual description specified in the [[color]] property. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

properties.label: colorist
properties.definition: The individual who adds color to inked drawings.

properties.label: comment
properties.definition: Comments, typically from users.

properties.label: companyRegistration
properties.definition: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

properties.label: competencyRequired
properties.definition: Knowledge, skill, ability or personal attribute that must be demonstrated by a person or other entity in order to do something such as earn an Educational Occupational Credential or understand a LearningResource.

properties.label: competitor
properties.definition: A competitor in a sports event.

properties.label: composer
properties.definition: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

properties.label: comprisedOf
properties.definition: Specifying something physically contained by something else. Typically used here for the underlying anatomical structures, such as organs, that comprise the anatomical system.

properties.label: connectedTo
properties.definition: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

properties.label: constraintProperty
properties.definition: Indicates a property used as a constraint. For example, in the definition of a [[StatisticalVariable]]. The value is a property, either from within Schema.org or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

properties.label: contactOption
properties.definition: An option available on this contact point (e.g. a toll-free number or support for hearing-impaired callers).

properties.label: contactPoint
properties.definition: A contact point for a person or organization.

properties.label: contactPoints
properties.definition: A contact point for a person or organization.

properties.label: containedIn
properties.definition: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

properties.label: containedInPlace
properties.definition: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

properties.label: containsPlace
properties.definition: The basic containment relation between a place and another that it contains.

properties.label: containsSeason
properties.definition: A season that is part of the media series.

properties.label: contentLocation
properties.definition: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

properties.label: contentRating
properties.definition: Official rating of a piece of content—for example, 'MPAA PG-13'.

properties.label: contraindication
properties.definition: A contraindication for this therapy.

properties.label: contributor
properties.definition: A secondary contributor to the CreativeWork or Event.

properties.label: cookTime
properties.definition: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

properties.label: copyrightHolder
properties.definition: The party holding the legal copyright to the CreativeWork.

properties.label: correction
properties.definition: Indicates a correction to a [[CreativeWork]], either via a [[CorrectionComment]], textually or in another document.

properties.label: correctionsPolicy
properties.definition: For an [[Organization]] (e.g. [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement describing (in news media, the newsroom’s) disclosure and correction policy for errors.

properties.label: costCategory
properties.definition: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

properties.label: costPerUnit
properties.definition: The cost per unit of the drug.

properties.label: countryOfOrigin
properties.definition: The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative works such as movie and TV content. In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of [[CreativeWork]] it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as [[contentLocation]] and [[locationCreated]] may be more applicable. In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. The exact interpretation of this may vary by context and product type, and cannot be fully enumerated here.

properties.label: course
properties.definition: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

properties.label: coursePrerequisites
properties.definition: Requirements for taking the Course. May be completion of another [[Course]] or a textual description like "permission of instructor". Requirements may be a pre-requisite competency, referenced using [[AlignmentObject]].

properties.label: courseSchedule
properties.definition: Represents the length and pace of a course, expressed as a [[Schedule]].

properties.label: creativeWorkStatus
properties.definition: The status of a creative work in terms of its stage in a lifecycle. Example terms include Incomplete, Draft, Published, Obsolete. Some organizations define a set of terms for the stages of their publication lifecycle.

properties.label: creator
properties.definition: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

properties.label: credentialCategory
properties.definition: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

properties.label: creditedTo
properties.definition: The group the release is credited to if different than the byArtist. For example, Red and Blue is credited to "Stefani Germanotta Band", but by Lady Gaga.

properties.label: currentExchangeRate
properties.definition: The current price of a currency.

properties.label: customer
properties.definition: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

properties.label: customerRemorseReturnFees
properties.definition: The type of return fees if the product is returned due to customer remorse.

properties.label: customerRemorseReturnLabelSource
properties.definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned due to customer remorse.

properties.label: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
properties.definition: The amount of shipping costs if a product is returned due to customer remorse. Applicable when property [[customerRemorseReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

properties.label: data
properties.definition: Data associated with the event, like for instance a log message.

properties.label: dataFeedElement
properties.definition: An item within a data feed. Data feeds may have many elements.

properties.label: dataset
properties.definition: A dataset contained in this catalog.

properties.label: dayOfWeek
properties.definition: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid.

properties.label: deathPlace
properties.definition: The place where the person died.

properties.label: defaultValue
properties.definition: The default value of the input. For properties that expect a literal, the default is a literal value, for properties that expect an object, it's an ID reference to one of the current values.

properties.label: deliveryAddress
properties.definition: Destination address.

properties.label: deliveryLeadTime
properties.definition: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

properties.label: deliveryMethod
properties.definition: A sub property of instrument. The method of delivery.

properties.label: deliveryStatus
properties.definition: New entry added as the package passes through each leg of its journey (from shipment to final delivery).

properties.label: deliveryTime
properties.definition: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.

properties.label: department
properties.definition: A relationship between an organization and a department of that organization, also described as an organization (allowing different urls, logos, opening hours). For example: a store with a pharmacy, or a bakery with a cafe.

properties.label: departureAirport
properties.definition: The airport where the flight originates.

properties.label: departureBoatTerminal
properties.definition: The terminal or port from which the boat departs.

properties.label: departureBusStop
properties.definition: The stop or station from which the bus departs.

properties.label: departureStation
properties.definition: The station from which the train departs.

properties.label: depth
properties.definition: The depth of the item.

properties.label: description
properties.definition: A description of the item.

properties.label: diagnosis
properties.definition: One or more alternative conditions considered in the differential diagnosis process as output of a diagnosis process.

properties.label: diagram
properties.definition: An image containing a diagram that illustrates the structure and/or its component substructures and/or connections with other structures.

properties.label: diet
properties.definition: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

properties.label: differentialDiagnosis
properties.definition: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.

properties.label: digitalSourceType
properties.definition: Indicates an IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration code indicating the nature of the digital source(s) for some [[CreativeWork]].

properties.label: director
properties.definition: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

properties.label: directors
properties.definition: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video games etc. content. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

properties.label: discusses
properties.definition: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.

properties.label: diseasePreventionInfo
properties.definition: Information about disease prevention.

properties.label: diseaseSpreadStatistics
properties.definition: Statistical information about the spread of a disease, either as [[WebContent]], or described directly as a [[Dataset]], or the specific [[Observation]]s in the dataset. When a [[WebContent]] URL is provided, the page indicated might also contain more such markup.

properties.label: displayLocation
properties.definition: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

properties.label: distance
properties.definition: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

properties.label: distinguishingSign
properties.definition: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.

properties.label: distribution
properties.definition: A downloadable form of this dataset, at a specific location, in a specific format. This property can be repeated if different variations are available. There is no expectation that different downloadable distributions must contain exactly equivalent information (see also [DCAT](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution) on this point). Different distributions might include or exclude different subsets of the entire dataset, for example.

properties.label: diversityPolicy
properties.definition: Statement on diversity policy by an [[Organization]] e.g. a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]. For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement describing the newsroom’s diversity policy on both staffing and sources, typically providing staffing data.

properties.label: diversityStaffingReport
properties.definition: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a report on staffing diversity issues. In a news context this might be for example ASNE or RTDNA (US) reports, or self-reported.

properties.label: documentation
properties.definition: Further documentation describing the Web API in more detail.

properties.label: domainIncludes
properties.definition: Relates a property to a class that is (one of) the type(s) the property is expected to be used on.

properties.label: doseSchedule
properties.definition: A dosing schedule for the drug for a given population, either observed, recommended, or maximum dose based on the type used.

properties.label: doseValue
properties.definition: The value of the dose, e.g. 500.

properties.label: downPayment
properties.definition: a type of payment made in cash during the onset of the purchase of an expensive good/service. The payment typically represents only a percentage of the full purchase price.

properties.label: drainsTo
properties.definition: The vasculature that the vein drains into.

properties.label: driveWheelConfiguration
properties.definition: The drive wheel configuration, i.e. which roadwheels will receive torque from the vehicle's engine via the drivetrain.

properties.label: dropoffLocation
properties.definition: Where a rental car can be dropped off.

properties.label: drug
properties.definition: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.

properties.label: drugClass
properties.definition: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).

properties.label: duplicateTherapy
properties.definition: A therapy that duplicates or overlaps this one.

properties.label: duration
properties.definition: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

properties.label: durationOfWarranty
properties.definition: The duration of the warranty promise. Common unitCode values are ANN for year, MON for months, or DAY for days.

properties.label: duringMedia
properties.definition: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

properties.label: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
properties.definition: The amount to be paid as a penalty in the event of early payment of the loan.

properties.label: editor
properties.definition: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

properties.label: educationRequirements
properties.definition: Educational background needed for the position or Occupation.

properties.label: educationalAlignment
properties.definition: An alignment to an established educational framework. This property should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

properties.label: educationalCredentialAwarded
properties.definition: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other educational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

properties.label: educationalLevel
properties.definition: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context. Examples of educational levels include 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced', and formal sets of level indicators.

properties.label: educationalUse
properties.definition: The purpose of a work in the context of education; for example, 'assignment', 'group work'.

properties.label: eligibleCustomerType
properties.definition: The type(s) of customers for which the given offer is valid.

properties.label: eligibleDuration
properties.definition: The duration for which the given offer is valid.

properties.label: eligibleQuantity
properties.definition: The interval and unit of measurement of ordering quantities for which the offer or price specification is valid. This allows e.g. specifying that a certain freight charge is valid only for a certain quantity.

properties.label: eligibleRegion
properties.definition: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

properties.label: eligibleTransactionVolume
properties.definition: The transaction volume, in a monetary unit, for which the offer or price specification is valid, e.g. for indicating a minimal purchasing volume, to express free shipping above a certain order volume, or to limit the acceptance of credit cards to purchases to a certain minimal amount.

properties.label: eligibleWithSupplier
properties.definition: The supplier of the incentivized item/service for which the incentive is valid for such as a utility company, merchant, or contractor.

properties.label: employee
properties.definition: Someone working for this organization.

properties.label: employees
properties.definition: People working for this organization.

properties.label: employmentUnit
properties.definition: Indicates the department, unit and/or facility where the employee reports and/or in which the job is to be performed.

properties.label: encodesBioChemEntity
properties.definition: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

properties.label: encodesCreativeWork
properties.definition: The CreativeWork encoded by this media object.

properties.label: encoding
properties.definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for associatedMedia.

properties.label: encodings
properties.definition: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork.

properties.label: endOffset
properties.definition: The end time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

properties.label: endorsee
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The person/organization being supported.

properties.label: endorsers
properties.definition: People or organizations that endorse the plan.

properties.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
properties.definition: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

properties.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
properties.definition: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

properties.label: engineDisplacement
properties.definition:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

properties.label: enginePower
properties.definition:
The power of the vehicle's engine. Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 3: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

properties.label: engineType
properties.definition: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

properties.label: entertainmentBusiness
properties.definition: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

properties.label: episode
properties.definition: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

properties.label: episodes
properties.definition: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

properties.label: equal
properties.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

properties.label: error
properties.definition: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

properties.label: errorCode
properties.definition: Application or platform dependant error code.

properties.label: estimatedCost
properties.definition: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.

properties.label: estimatedFlightDuration
properties.definition: The estimated time the flight will take.

properties.label: estimatedSalary
properties.definition: An estimated salary for a job posting or occupation, based on a variety of variables including, but not limited to industry, job title, and location. Estimated salaries are often computed by outside organizations rather than the hiring organization, who may not have committed to the estimated value.

properties.label: estimatesRiskOf
properties.definition: The condition, complication, or symptom whose risk is being estimated.

properties.label: ethicsPolicy
properties.definition: Statement about ethics policy, e.g. of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] regarding journalistic and publishing practices, or of a [[Restaurant]], a page describing food source policies. In the case of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], an ethicsPolicy is typically a statement describing the personal, organizational, and corporate standards of behavior expected by the organization.

properties.label: event
properties.definition: Upcoming or past event associated with this place, organization, or action.

properties.label: eventAttendanceMode
properties.definition: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

properties.label: eventSchedule
properties.definition: Associates an [[Event]] with a [[Schedule]]. There are circumstances where it is preferable to share a schedule for a series of repeating events rather than data on the individual events themselves. For example, a website or application might prefer to publish a schedule for a weekly gym class rather than provide data on every event. A schedule could be processed by applications to add forthcoming events to a calendar. An [[Event]] that is associated with a [[Schedule]] using this property should not have [[startDate]] or [[endDate]] properties. These are instead defined within the associated [[Schedule]], this avoids any ambiguity for clients using the data. The property might have repeated values to specify different schedules, e.g. for different months or seasons.

properties.label: eventStatus
properties.definition: An eventStatus of an event represents its status; particularly useful when an event is cancelled or rescheduled.

properties.label: events
properties.definition: Upcoming or past events associated with this place or organization.

properties.label: evidenceLevel
properties.definition: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).

properties.label: exampleOfWork
properties.definition: A creative work that this work is an example/instance/realization/derivation of.

properties.label: exchangeRateSpread
properties.definition: The difference between the price at which a broker or other intermediary buys and sells foreign currency.

properties.label: exerciseCourse
properties.definition: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

properties.label: exercisePlan
properties.definition: A sub property of instrument. The exercise plan used on this action.

properties.label: exerciseRelatedDiet
properties.definition: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

properties.label: exifData
properties.definition: exif data for this object.

properties.label: expectsAcceptanceOf
properties.definition: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

properties.label: experienceRequirements
properties.definition: Description of skills and experience needed for the position or Occupation.

properties.label: expressedIn
properties.definition: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

properties.label: fatContent
properties.definition: The number of grams of fat.

properties.label: fiberContent
properties.definition: The number of grams of fiber.

properties.label: financialAidEligible
properties.definition: A financial aid type or program which students may use to pay for tuition or fees associated with the program.

properties.label: firstAppearance
properties.definition: Indicates the first known occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

properties.label: firstPerformance
properties.definition: The date and place the work was first performed.

properties.label: flightDistance
properties.definition: The distance of the flight.

properties.label: floorLimit
properties.definition: A floor limit is the amount of money above which credit card transactions must be authorized.

properties.label: floorSize
properties.definition: The size of the accommodation, e.g. in square meter or squarefoot. Typical unit code(s): MTK for square meter, FTK for square foot, or YDK for square yard.

properties.label: followee
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The person or organization being followed.

properties.label: follows
properties.definition: The most generic uni-directional social relation.

properties.label: foodEstablishment
properties.definition: A sub property of location. The specific food establishment where the action occurred.

properties.label: foodEvent
properties.definition: A sub property of location. The specific food event where the action occurred.

properties.label: founder
properties.definition: A person or organization who founded this organization.

properties.label: founders
properties.definition: A person who founded this organization.

properties.label: foundingLocation
properties.definition: The place where the Organization was founded.

properties.label: freeShippingThreshold
properties.definition: A monetary value above (or at) which the shipping rate becomes free. Intended to be used via an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with [[shippingSettingsLink]] matching this [[ShippingRateSettings]].

properties.label: fromLocation
properties.definition: A sub property of location. The original location of the object or the agent before the action.

properties.label: fuelCapacity
properties.definition: The capacity of the fuel tank or in the case of electric cars, the battery. If there are multiple components for storage, this should indicate the total of all storage of the same type.\n\nTypical unit code(s): LTR for liters, GLL of US gallons, GLI for UK / imperial gallons, AMH for ampere-hours (for electrical vehicles).

properties.label: fuelConsumption
properties.definition:
The amount of fuel consumed for traveling a particular distance or temporal duration with the given vehicle (e.g. liters per 100 km).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for liters per 100 km. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. L/100 km.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel consumption to another value.

properties.label: fuelEfficiency
properties.definition:
The distance traveled per unit of fuel used; most commonly miles per gallon (mpg) or kilometers per liter (km/L).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for miles per gallon or kilometers per liter. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. mpg or km/L.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel economy to another value.

properties.label: fuelType
properties.definition: The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle. If the vehicle has only one engine, this property can be attached directly to the vehicle.

properties.label: fulfillmentType
properties.definition: Type of fulfillment applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

properties.label: functionalClass
properties.definition: The degree of mobility the joint allows.

properties.label: fundedItem
properties.definition: Indicates something directly or indirectly funded or sponsored through a [[Grant]]. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

properties.label: funder
properties.definition: A person or organization that supports (sponsors) something through some kind of financial contribution.

properties.label: funding
properties.definition: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

properties.label: game
properties.definition: Video game which is played on this server.

properties.label: gameAvailabilityType
properties.definition: Indicates the availability type of the game content associated with this action, such as whether it is a full version or a demo.

properties.label: gameItem
properties.definition: An item is an object within the game world that can be collected by a player or, occasionally, a non-player character.

properties.label: gameLocation
properties.definition: Real or fictional location of the game (or part of game).

properties.label: gamePlatform
properties.definition: The electronic systems used to play video games.

properties.label: gameServer
properties.definition: The server on which it is possible to play the game.

properties.label: gameTip
properties.definition: Links to tips, tactics, etc.

properties.label: gender
properties.definition: Gender of something, typically a [[Person]], but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While https://schema.org/Male and https://schema.org/Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who are not a binary gender. The [[gender]] property can also be used in an extended sense to cover e.g. the gender of sports teams. As with the gender of individuals, we do not try to enumerate all possibilities. A mixed-gender [[SportsTeam]] can be indicated with a text value of "Mixed".

properties.label: genre
properties.definition: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

properties.label: geo
properties.definition: The geo coordinates of the place.

properties.label: geoContains
properties.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a containing geometry to a contained geometry. "a contains b iff no points of b lie in the exterior of a, and at least one point of the interior of b lies in the interior of a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geoCoveredBy
properties.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that covers it. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geoCovers
properties.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a covering geometry to a covered geometry. "Every point of b is a point of (the interior or boundary of) a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geoCrosses
properties.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that crosses it: "a crosses b: they have some but not all interior points in common, and the dimension of the intersection is less than that of at least one of them". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geoDisjoint
properties.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically disjoint: "they have no point in common. They form a set of disconnected geometries." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

properties.label: geoEquals
properties.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically equal, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM). "Two geometries are topologically equal if their interiors intersect and no part of the interior or boundary of one geometry intersects the exterior of the other" (a symmetric relationship).

properties.label: geoIntersects
properties.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) have at least one point in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geoMidpoint
properties.definition: Indicates the GeoCoordinates at the centre of a GeoShape, e.g. GeoCircle.

properties.label: geoOverlaps
properties.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that geospatially overlaps it, i.e. they have some but not all points in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geoRadius
properties.definition: Indicates the approximate radius of a GeoCircle (metres unless indicated otherwise via Distance notation).

properties.label: geoTouches
properties.definition: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) touch: "they have at least one boundary point in common, but no interior points." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

properties.label: geoWithin
properties.definition: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to one that contains it, i.e. it is inside (i.e. within) its interior. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

properties.label: geographicArea
properties.definition: The geographic area associated with the audience.

properties.label: gettingTestedInfo
properties.definition: Information about getting tested (for a [[MedicalCondition]]), e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

properties.label: governmentBenefitsInfo
properties.definition: governmentBenefitsInfo provides information about government benefits associated with a SpecialAnnouncement.

properties.label: gracePeriod
properties.definition: The period of time after any due date that the borrower has to fulfil its obligations before a default (failure to pay) is deemed to have occurred.

properties.label: grantee
properties.definition: The person, organization, contact point, or audience that has been granted this permission.

properties.label: greater
properties.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than the object.

properties.label: greaterOrEqual
properties.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is greater than or equal to the object.

properties.label: guideline
