properties.definition: A medical guideline related to this entity.

properties.label: guidelineSubject
properties.definition: The medical conditions, treatments, etc. that are the subject of the guideline.

properties.label: handlingTime
properties.definition: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup. In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY). This is by common convention assumed to mean business days (if a unitCode is used, coded as "d"), i.e. only counting days when the business normally operates. In the context of [[ShippingService]], use the [[ServicePeriod]] format, that contains the same information in a structured form, with cut-off time, business days and duration.

properties.label: hasAdultConsideration
properties.definition: Used to tag an item to be intended or suitable for consumption or use by adults only.

properties.label: hasBioChemEntityPart
properties.definition: Indicates a BioChemEntity that (in some sense) has this BioChemEntity as a part.

properties.label: hasBroadcastChannel
properties.definition: A broadcast channel of a broadcast service.

properties.label: hasCategoryCode
properties.definition: A Category code contained in this code set.

properties.label: hasCertification
properties.definition: Certification information about a product, organization, service, place, or person.

properties.label: hasCourse
properties.definition: A course or class that is one of the learning opportunities that constitute an educational / occupational program. No information is implied about whether the course is mandatory or optional; no guarantee is implied about whether the course will be available to everyone on the program.

properties.label: hasCourseInstance
properties.definition: An offering of the course at a specific time and place or through specific media or mode of study or to a specific section of students.

properties.label: hasCredential
properties.definition: A credential awarded to the Person or Organization.

properties.label: hasDefinedTerm
properties.definition: A Defined Term contained in this term set.

properties.label: hasDeliveryMethod
properties.definition: Method used for delivery or shipping.

properties.label: hasDigitalDocumentPermission
properties.definition: A permission related to the access to this document (e.g. permission to read or write an electronic document). For a public document, specify a grantee with an Audience with audienceType equal to "public".

properties.label: hasEnergyConsumptionDetails
properties.definition: Defines the energy efficiency Category (also known as "class" or "rating") for a product according to an international energy efficiency standard.

properties.label: hasEnergyEfficiencyCategory
properties.definition: Defines the energy efficiency Category (which could be either a rating out of range of values or a yes/no certification) for a product according to an international energy efficiency standard.

properties.label: hasHealthAspect
properties.definition: Indicates the aspect or aspects specifically addressed in some [[HealthTopicContent]]. For example, that the content is an overview, or that it talks about treatment, self-care, treatments or their side-effects.

properties.label: hasMap
properties.definition: A URL to a map of the place.

properties.label: hasMeasurement
properties.definition: A measurement of an item, For example, the inseam of pants, the wheel size of a bicycle, the gauge of a screw, or the carbon footprint measured for certification by an authority. Usually an exact measurement, but can also be a range of measurements for adjustable products, for example belts and ski bindings.

properties.label: hasMemberProgram
properties.definition: MemberProgram offered by an Organization, for example an eCommerce merchant or an airline.

properties.label: hasMenu
properties.definition: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

properties.label: hasMenuItem
properties.definition: A food or drink item contained in a menu or menu section.

properties.label: hasMenuSection
properties.definition: A subgrouping of the menu (by dishes, course, serving time period, etc.).

properties.label: hasMerchantReturnPolicy
properties.definition: Specifies a MerchantReturnPolicy that may be applicable.

properties.label: hasMolecularFunction
properties.definition: Molecular function performed by this BioChemEntity; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

properties.label: hasOccupation
properties.definition: The Person's occupation. For past professions, use Role for expressing dates.

properties.label: hasOfferCatalog
properties.definition: Indicates an OfferCatalog listing for this Organization, Person, or Service.

properties.label: hasPOS
properties.definition: Points-of-Sales operated by the organization or person.

properties.label: hasPart
properties.definition: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that is part of this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense).

properties.label: hasParticipationOffer
properties.definition: An offer to participate in the event, for example, Call for Proposals, Call for Speakers, or Call for Performers.

properties.label: hasRepresentation
properties.definition: A common representation such as a protein sequence or chemical structure for this entity. For images use schema.org/image.

properties.label: hasShippingService
properties.definition: Specification of a shipping service offered by the organization.

properties.label: hasSponsorshipOffer
properties.definition: An offer to sponsor the event, for example, Sponsorship Prospectus, Sponsorship Opportunities, or Sponsor Packages.

properties.label: hasStore
properties.definition: An eCommerce store part of an online marketplace.

properties.label: hasTierBenefit
properties.definition: A member benefit for a particular tier of a loyalty program.

properties.label: hasTierRequirement
properties.definition: A requirement for a user to join a membership tier, for example: a CreditCard if the tier requires sign up for a credit card, A UnitPriceSpecification if the user is required to pay a (periodic) fee, or a MonetaryAmount if the user needs to spend a minimum amount to join the tier. If a tier is free to join then this property does not need to be specified.

properties.label: hasTiers
properties.definition: The tiers of a member program.

properties.label: hasVariant
properties.definition: Indicates a [[Product]] that is a member of this [[ProductGroup]] (or [[ProductModel]]).

properties.label: healthCondition
properties.definition: Specifying the health condition(s) of a patient, medical study, or other target audience.

properties.label: healthPlanCopay
properties.definition: The copay amount.

properties.label: healthPlanCostSharing
properties.definition: The costs to the patient for services under this network or formulary.

properties.label: healthcareReportingData
properties.definition: Indicates data describing a hospital, e.g. a CDC [[CDCPMDRecord]] or as some kind of [[Dataset]].

properties.label: height
properties.definition: The height of the item.

properties.label: hiringOrganization
properties.definition: Organization or Person offering the job position.

properties.label: holdingArchive
properties.definition: [[ArchiveOrganization]] that holds, keeps or maintains the [[ArchiveComponent]].

properties.label: homeLocation
properties.definition: A contact location for a person's residence.

properties.label: homeTeam
properties.definition: The home team in a sports event.

properties.label: hospitalAffiliation
properties.definition: A hospital with which the physician or office is affiliated.

properties.label: hostingOrganization
properties.definition: The Organization (airline, travelers' club, retailer, etc.) the membership is made with or which offers the MemberProgram.

properties.label: hoursAvailable
properties.definition: The hours during which this service or contact is available.

properties.label: identifier
properties.definition: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.

properties.label: identifyingExam
properties.definition: A physical examination that can identify this sign.

properties.label: identifyingTest
properties.definition: A diagnostic test that can identify this sign.

properties.label: illustrator
properties.definition: The illustrator of the book.

properties.label: image
properties.definition: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

properties.label: imagingTechnique
properties.definition: Imaging technique used.

properties.label: inAlbum
properties.definition: The album to which this recording belongs.

properties.label: inBroadcastLineup
properties.definition: The CableOrSatelliteService offering the channel.

properties.label: inCodeSet
properties.definition: A [[CategoryCodeSet]] that contains this category code.

properties.label: inDefinedTermSet
properties.definition: A [[DefinedTermSet]] that contains this term.

properties.label: inLanguage
properties.definition: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].

properties.label: inPlaylist
properties.definition: The playlist to which this recording belongs.

properties.label: incentiveAmount
properties.definition:
Describes the amount that can be redeemed from this incentive.

[[QuantitativeValue]]: Use this for incentives based on price (either raw amount or percentage-based). For a raw amount example, "You can claim $2,500 - $7,500 from the total cost of installation" would be represented as the following:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", “minValue”: 2500, “maxValue”: 7500, "unitCode": "USD" }

[[QuantitativeValue]] can also be used for percentage amounts. In such cases, value is used to represent the incentive’s percentage, while maxValue represents a limit (if one exists) to that incentive. The unitCode should be 'P1' and the unitText should be '%', while valueReference should be used for holding the currency type. For example, "You can claim up to 30% of the total cost of installation, up to a maximum of $7,500" would be:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "value": 30, "unitCode": "P1", "unitText": "%", “maxValue”: 7500, “valueReference”: “USD” }

[[UnitPriceSpecification]]: Use this for incentives that are based on amounts rather than price. For example, a net metering rebate that pays $10/kWh, up to $1,000:

{ "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "price": 10, "priceCurrency": "USD", "referenceQuantity": 1, "unitCode": "DO3", "unitText": "kw/h", "maxPrice": 1000, "description": "$10 / kwh up to $1000" }

[[LoanOrCredit]]: Use for incentives that are loan based. For example, a loan of $4,000 - $50,000 with a repayment term of 10 years, interest free would look like:

{ "@type": "LoanOrCredit", "loanTerm": { "@type":"QuantitativeValue", "value":"10", "unitCode": "ANN" }, "amount":[ { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "Name":"fixed interest rate", "value":"0", }, ], "amount":[ { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"min loan amount", "value":"4000", "currency":"CAD" }, { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"max loan amount", "value":"50000", "currency":"CAD" } ], } In summary:
  • Use [[QuantitativeValue]] for absolute/percentage-based incentives applied on the price of a good/service.
  • Use [[UnitPriceSpecification]] for incentives based on a per-unit basis (e.g. net metering).
  • Use [[LoanOrCredit]] for loans/credits.
.

properties.label: incentiveStatus
properties.definition: The status of the incentive (active, on hold, retired, etc.).

properties.label: incentiveType
properties.definition: The type of incentive offered (tax credit/rebate, tax deduction, tax waiver, subsidies, etc.).

properties.label: incentivizedItem
properties.definition:
The type or specific product(s) and/or service(s) being incentivized.

DefinedTermSets are used for product and service categories such as the United Nations Standard Products and Services Code:

{ "@type": "DefinedTerm", "inDefinedTermSet": "https://www.unspsc.org/", "termCode": "261315XX", "name": "Photovoltaic module" }

For a specific product or service, use the Product type:

{ "@type": "Product", "name": "Kenmore White 17" Microwave", } For multiple different incentivized items, use multiple [[DefinedTerm]] or [[Product]].

properties.label: includedComposition
properties.definition: Smaller compositions included in this work (e.g. a movement in a symphony).

properties.label: includedDataCatalog
properties.definition: A data catalog which contains this dataset (this property was previously 'catalog', preferred name is now 'includedInDataCatalog').

properties.label: includedInDataCatalog
properties.definition: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

properties.label: includedInHealthInsurancePlan
properties.definition: The insurance plans that cover this drug.

properties.label: includedRiskFactor
properties.definition: A modifiable or non-modifiable risk factor included in the calculation, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

properties.label: includesAttraction
properties.definition: Attraction located at destination.

properties.label: includesHealthPlanFormulary
properties.definition: Formularies covered by this plan.

properties.label: includesHealthPlanNetwork
properties.definition: Networks covered by this plan.

properties.label: includesObject
properties.definition: This links to a node or nodes indicating the exact quantity of the products included in an [[Offer]] or [[ProductCollection]].

properties.label: incomeLimit
properties.definition:
Optional. Income limit for which the incentive is applicable for.

If MonetaryAmount is specified, this should be based on annualized income (e.g. if an incentive is limited to those making <$114,000 annually):

{ "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "maxValue": 114000, "currency": "USD", } Use Text for incentives that are limited based on other criteria, for example if an incentive is only available to recipients making 120% of the median poverty income in their area.

properties.label: increasesRiskOf
properties.definition: The condition, complication, etc. influenced by this factor.

properties.label: industry
properties.definition: The industry associated with the job position.

properties.label: ineligibleRegion
properties.definition: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is not valid, e.g. a region where the transaction is not allowed.\n\nSee also [[eligibleRegion]].

properties.label: infectiousAgentClass
properties.definition: The class of infectious agent (bacteria, prion, etc.) that causes the disease.

properties.label: inker
properties.definition: The individual who traces over the pencil drawings in ink after pencils are complete.

properties.label: insertion
properties.definition: The place of attachment of a muscle, or what the muscle moves.

properties.label: instructor
properties.definition: A person assigned to instruct or provide instructional assistance for the [[CourseInstance]].

properties.label: instrument
properties.definition: The object that helped the agent perform the action. E.g. John wrote a book with *a pen*.

properties.label: intensity
properties.definition: Quantitative measure gauging the degree of force involved in the exercise, for example, heartbeats per minute. May include the velocity of the movement.

properties.label: interactingDrug
properties.definition: Another drug that is known to interact with this drug in a way that impacts the effect of this drug or causes a risk to the patient. Note: disease interactions are typically captured as contraindications.

properties.label: interactionService
properties.definition: The WebSite or SoftwareApplication where the interactions took place.

properties.label: interactionStatistic
properties.definition: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication. The most specific child type of InteractionCounter should be used.

properties.label: interactionType
properties.definition: The Action representing the type of interaction. For up votes, +1s, etc. use [[LikeAction]]. For down votes use [[DislikeAction]]. Otherwise, use the most specific Action.

properties.label: interestRate
properties.definition: The interest rate, charged or paid, applicable to the financial product. Note: This is different from the calculated annualPercentageRate.

properties.label: interpretedAsClaim
properties.definition: Used to indicate a specific claim contained, implied, translated or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. The interpreting party can be indicated using [[claimInterpreter]].

properties.label: inventoryLevel
properties.definition: The current approximate inventory level for the item or items.

properties.label: inverseOf
properties.definition: Relates a property to a property that is its inverse. Inverse properties relate the same pairs of items to each other, but in reversed direction. For example, the 'alumni' and 'alumniOf' properties are inverseOf each other. Some properties don't have explicit inverses; in these situations RDFa and JSON-LD syntax for reverse properties can be used.

properties.label: isAccessoryOrSparePartFor
properties.definition: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is an accessory or spare part.

properties.label: isBasedOn
properties.definition: A resource from which this work is derived or from which it is a modification or adaptation.

properties.label: isBasedOnUrl
properties.definition: A resource that was used in the creation of this resource. This term can be repeated for multiple sources. For example, http://example.com/great-multiplication-intro.html.

properties.label: isConsumableFor
properties.definition: A pointer to another product (or multiple products) for which this product is a consumable.

properties.label: isEncodedByBioChemEntity
properties.definition: Another BioChemEntity encoding by this one.

properties.label: isInvolvedInBiologicalProcess
properties.definition: Biological process this BioChemEntity is involved in; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

properties.label: isLocatedInSubcellularLocation
properties.definition: Subcellular location where this BioChemEntity is located; please use PropertyValue if you want to include any evidence.

properties.label: isPartOf
properties.definition: Indicates an item or CreativeWork that this item, or CreativeWork (in some sense), is part of.

properties.label: isPartOfBioChemEntity
properties.definition: Indicates a BioChemEntity that is (in some sense) a part of this BioChemEntity.

properties.label: isPlanForApartment
properties.definition: Indicates some accommodation that this floor plan describes.

properties.label: isRelatedTo
properties.definition: A pointer to another, somehow related product (or multiple products).

properties.label: isSimilarTo
properties.definition: A pointer to another, functionally similar product (or multiple products).

properties.label: isStoreOn
properties.definition: The eCommerce marketplace this online store is on.

properties.label: isTierOf
properties.definition: The member program this tier is a part of.

properties.label: isVariantOf
properties.definition: Indicates the kind of product that this is a variant of. In the case of [[ProductModel]], this is a pointer (from a ProductModel) to a base product from which this product is a variant. It is safe to infer that the variant inherits all product features from the base model, unless defined locally. This is not transitive. In the case of a [[ProductGroup]], the group description also serves as a template, representing a set of Products that vary on explicitly defined, specific dimensions only (so it defines both a set of variants, as well as which values distinguish amongst those variants). When used with [[ProductGroup]], this property can apply to any [[Product]] included in the group.

properties.label: issuedBy
properties.definition: The organization issuing the item, for example a [[Permit]], [[Ticket]], or [[Certification]].

properties.label: issuedThrough
properties.definition: The service through which the permit was granted.

properties.label: item
properties.definition: An entity represented by an entry in a list or data feed (e.g. an 'artist' in a list of 'artists').

properties.label: itemCondition
properties.definition: A predefined value from OfferItemCondition specifying the condition of the product or service, or the products or services included in the offer. Also used for product return policies to specify the condition of products accepted for returns.

properties.label: itemDefectReturnFees
properties.definition: The type of return fees for returns of defect products.

properties.label: itemDefectReturnLabelSource
properties.definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a defect product.

properties.label: itemDefectReturnShippingFeesAmount
properties.definition: Amount of shipping costs for defect product returns. Applicable when property [[itemDefectReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

properties.label: itemListElement
properties.definition:
For itemListElement values, you can use simple strings (e.g. "Peter", "Paul", "Mary"), existing entities, or use ListItem.

Text values are best if the elements in the list are plain strings. Existing entities are best for a simple, unordered list of existing things in your data. ListItem is used with ordered lists when you want to provide additional context about the element in that list or when the same item might be in different places in different lists.

Note: The order of elements in your mark-up is not sufficient for indicating the order or elements. Use ListItem with a 'position' property in such cases.

properties.label: itemListOrder
properties.definition: Type of ordering (e.g. Ascending, Descending, Unordered).

properties.label: itemLocation
properties.definition: Current location of the item.

properties.label: itemOffered
properties.definition: An item being offered (or demanded). The transactional nature of the offer or demand is documented using [[businessFunction]], e.g. sell, lease etc. While several common expected types are listed explicitly in this definition, others can be used. Using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

properties.label: itemReviewed
properties.definition: The item that is being reviewed/rated.

properties.label: itemShipped
properties.definition: Item(s) being shipped.

properties.label: itinerary
properties.definition: Destination(s) ( [[Place]] ) that make up a trip. For a trip where destination order is important use [[ItemList]] to specify that order (see examples).

properties.label: jobDuration
properties.definition: The expected duration of an employment offer as advertised by the employer. Relevant for job postings that have a clearly defined period in mind such as seasonal work, substitutes for maternal leave or any other temporary employment.

properties.label: jobLocation
properties.definition: A (typically single) geographic location associated with the job position.

properties.label: jobTitle
properties.definition: The job title of the person (for example, Financial Manager).

properties.label: jurisdiction
properties.definition: Indicates a legal jurisdiction, e.g. of some legislation, or where some government service is based.

properties.label: keywords
properties.definition: Keywords or tags used to describe some item. Multiple textual entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas, or by repeating the property.

properties.label: knows
properties.definition: The most generic bi-directional social/work relation.

properties.label: knowsAbout
properties.definition: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a topic that is known about - suggesting possible expertise but not implying it. We do not distinguish skill levels here, or relate this to educational content, events, objectives or [[JobPosting]] descriptions.

properties.label: knowsLanguage
properties.definition: Of a [[Person]], and less typically of an [[Organization]], to indicate a known language. We do not distinguish skill levels or reading/writing/speaking/signing here. Use language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

properties.label: landlord
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The owner of the real estate property.

properties.label: language
properties.definition: A sub property of instrument. The language used on this action.

properties.label: layoutImage
properties.definition: A schematic image showing the floorplan layout.

properties.label: learningResourceType
properties.definition: The predominant type or kind characterizing the learning resource. For example, 'presentation', 'handout'.

properties.label: leaseLength
properties.definition: Length of the lease for some [[Accommodation]], either particular to some [[Offer]] or in some cases intrinsic to the property.

properties.label: legalAddress
properties.definition: The legal address of an organization which acts as the officially registered address used for legal and tax purposes. The legal address can be different from the place of operations of a business and other addresses can be part of an organization.

properties.label: legalRepresentative
properties.definition: One or multiple persons who represent this organization legally such as CEO or sole administrator.

properties.label: legalStatus
properties.definition: The drug or supplement's legal status, including any controlled substance schedules that apply.

properties.label: legislationAmends
properties.definition: Another legislation that this legislation amends, introducing legal changes.

properties.label: legislationApplies
properties.definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of a legislation) somehow transfers another legislation in a different legislative context. This is an informative link, and it has no legal value. For legally-binding links of transposition, use the legislationTransposes property. For example an informative consolidated law of a European Union's member state "applies" the consolidated version of the European Directive implemented in it.

properties.label: legislationChanges
properties.definition: Another legislation that this legislation changes. This encompasses the notions of amendment, replacement, correction, repeal, or other types of change. This may be a direct change (textual or non-textual amendment) or a consequential or indirect change. The property is to be used to express the existence of a change relationship between two acts rather than the existence of a consolidated version of the text that shows the result of the change. For consolidation relationships, use the legislationConsolidates property.

properties.label: legislationCommences
properties.definition: Another legislation that this one sets into force.

properties.label: legislationConsolidates
properties.definition: Indicates another legislation taken into account in this consolidated legislation (which is usually the product of an editorial process that revises the legislation). This property should be used multiple times to refer to both the original version or the previous consolidated version, and to the legislations making the change.

properties.label: legislationCorrects
properties.definition: Another legislation in which this one introduces textual changes, like correction of spelling mistakes, with no legal impact (for modifications that have legal impact, use legislationAmends).

properties.label: legislationCountersignedBy
properties.definition: The person or organization that countersigned the legislation. Depending on the legal context, a countersignature can indicate that the signed authority undertakes to assume responsibility for texts emanating from a person who is inviolable and irresponsible, (for example a King, Grand Duc or President), or that the authority is in charge of the implementation of the text.

properties.label: legislationEnsuresImplementationOf
properties.definition: Indicates that this Legislation ensures the implementation of another Legislation, for example by modifying national legislations so that they do not contradict to an EU regulation or decision. This implies a legal meaning. Transpositions of EU Directive should be captured with legislationTransposes.

properties.label: legislationJurisdiction
properties.definition: The jurisdiction from which the legislation originates.

properties.label: legislationLegalForce
properties.definition: Whether the legislation is currently in force, not in force, or partially in force.

properties.label: legislationLegalValue
properties.definition: The legal value of this legislation file. The same legislation can be written in multiple files with different legal values. Typically a digitally signed PDF have a "stronger" legal value than the HTML file of the same act.

properties.label: legislationPassedBy
properties.definition: The person or organization that originally passed or made the law: typically parliament (for primary legislation) or government (for secondary legislation). This indicates the "legal author" of the law, as opposed to its physical author.

properties.label: legislationRepeals
properties.definition: Another legislation that this legislation repeals (cancels, abrogates).

properties.label: legislationResponsible
properties.definition: An individual or organization that has some kind of responsibility for the legislation. Typically the ministry who is/was in charge of elaborating the legislation, or the adressee for potential questions about the legislation once it is published.

properties.label: legislationTransposes
properties.definition: Indicates that this legislation (or part of legislation) fulfills the objectives set by another legislation, by passing appropriate implementation measures. Typically, some legislations of European Union's member states or regions transpose European Directives. This indicates a legally binding link between the 2 legislations.

properties.label: legislationType
properties.definition: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "règlement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

properties.label: lender
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The person that lends the object being borrowed.

properties.label: lesser
properties.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than the object.

properties.label: lesserOrEqual
properties.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is lesser than or equal to the object.

properties.label: letterer
properties.definition: The individual who adds lettering, including speech balloons and sound effects, to artwork.

properties.label: license
properties.definition: A license document that applies to this content, typically indicated by URL.

properties.label: lifeEvent
properties.definition: A life event like baptism, communions, Bar Mitzvahs, Aqiqah, Namakarana, Miyamairi, burial, ....

properties.label: liveBlogUpdate
properties.definition: An update to the LiveBlog.

properties.label: loanMortgageMandateAmount
properties.definition: Amount of mortgage mandate that can be converted into a proper mortgage at a later stage.

properties.label: loanPaymentAmount
properties.definition: The amount of money to pay in a single payment.

properties.label: loanRepaymentForm
properties.definition: A form of paying back money previously borrowed from a lender. Repayment usually takes the form of periodic payments that normally include part principal plus interest in each payment.

properties.label: loanTerm
properties.definition: The duration of the loan or credit agreement.

properties.label: location
properties.definition: The location of, for example, where an event is happening, where an organization is located, or where an action takes place.

properties.label: locationCreated
properties.definition: The location where the CreativeWork was created, which may not be the same as the location depicted in the CreativeWork.

properties.label: lodgingUnitType
properties.definition: Textual description of the unit type (including suite vs. room, size of bed, etc.).

properties.label: logo
properties.definition: An associated logo.

properties.label: loser
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The loser of the action.

properties.label: lyricist
properties.definition: The person who wrote the words.

properties.label: lyrics
properties.definition: The words in the song.

properties.label: mainContentOfPage
properties.definition: Indicates if this web page element is the main subject of the page.

properties.label: mainEntity
properties.definition: Indicates the primary entity described in some page or other CreativeWork.

properties.label: mainEntityOfPage
properties.definition: Indicates a page (or other CreativeWork) for which this thing is the main entity being described. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#mainEntityBackground) for details.

properties.label: maintainer
properties.definition: A maintainer of a [[Dataset]], software package ([[SoftwareApplication]]), or other [[Project]]. A maintainer is a [[Person]] or [[Organization]] that manages contributions to, and/or publication of, some (typically complex) artifact. It is common for distributions of software and data to be based on "upstream" sources. When [[maintainer]] is applied to a specific version of something e.g. a particular version or packaging of a [[Dataset]], it is always possible that the upstream source has a different maintainer. The [[isBasedOn]] property can be used to indicate such relationships between datasets to make the different maintenance roles clear. Similarly in the case of software, a package may have dedicated maintainers working on integration into software distributions such as Ubuntu, as well as upstream maintainers of the underlying work.

properties.label: makesOffer
properties.definition: A pointer to products or services offered by the organization or person.

properties.label: manufacturer
properties.definition: The manufacturer of the product.

properties.label: mapType
properties.definition: Indicates the kind of Map, from the MapCategoryType Enumeration.

properties.label: marginOfError
properties.definition: A [[marginOfError]] for an [[Observation]].

properties.label: masthead
properties.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a link to the masthead page or a page listing top editorial management.

properties.label: material
properties.definition: A material that something is made from, e.g. leather, wool, cotton, paper.

properties.label: materialExtent
properties.definition: The quantity of the materials being described or an expression of the physical space they occupy.

properties.label: mathExpression
properties.definition: A mathematical expression (e.g. 'x^2-3x=0') that may be solved for a specific variable, simplified, or transformed. This can take many formats, e.g. LaTeX, Ascii-Math, or math as you would write with a keyboard.

properties.label: maximumIntake
properties.definition: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

properties.label: measuredProperty
properties.definition: The measuredProperty of an [[Observation]], typically via its [[StatisticalVariable]]. There are various kinds of applicable [[Property]]: a schema.org property, a property from other RDF-compatible systems, e.g. W3C RDF Data Cube, Data Commons, Wikidata, or schema.org extensions such as [GS1's](https://www.gs1.org/voc/?show=properties).

properties.label: measurementDenominator
properties.definition: Identifies the denominator variable when an observation represents a ratio or percentage.

properties.label: measurementMethod
properties.definition: A subproperty of [[measurementTechnique]] that can be used for specifying specific methods, in particular via [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

properties.label: measurementQualifier
properties.definition: Provides additional qualification to an observation. For example, a GDP observation measures the Nominal value.

properties.label: measurementTechnique
properties.definition: A technique, method or technology used in an [[Observation]], [[StatisticalVariable]] or [[Dataset]] (or [[DataDownload]], [[DataCatalog]]), corresponding to the method used for measuring the corresponding variable(s) (for datasets, described using [[variableMeasured]]; for [[Observation]], a [[StatisticalVariable]]). Often but not necessarily each [[variableMeasured]] will have an explicit representation as (or mapping to) an property such as those defined in Schema.org, or other RDF vocabularies and "knowledge graphs". In that case the subproperty of [[variableMeasured]] called [[measuredProperty]] is applicable. The [[measurementTechnique]] property helps when extra clarification is needed about how a [[measuredProperty]] was measured. This is oriented towards scientific and scholarly dataset publication but may have broader applicability; it is not intended as a full representation of measurement, but can often serve as a high level summary for dataset discovery. For example, if [[variableMeasured]] is: molecule concentration, [[measurementTechnique]] could be: "mass spectrometry" or "nmr spectroscopy" or "colorimetry" or "immunofluorescence". If the [[variableMeasured]] is "depression rating", the [[measurementTechnique]] could be "Zung Scale" or "HAM-D" or "Beck Depression Inventory". If there are several [[variableMeasured]] properties recorded for some given data object, use a [[PropertyValue]] for each [[variableMeasured]] and attach the corresponding [[measurementTechnique]]. The value can also be from an enumeration, organized as a [[MeasurementMethodEnum]].

properties.label: mediaAuthenticityCategory
properties.definition: Indicates a MediaManipulationRatingEnumeration classification of a media object (in the context of how it was published or shared).

properties.label: mediaItemAppearance
properties.definition: In the context of a [[MediaReview]], indicates specific media item(s) that are grouped using a [[MediaReviewItem]].

properties.label: medicalAudience
properties.definition: Medical audience for page.

properties.label: medicalSpecialty
properties.definition: A medical specialty of the provider.

properties.label: medicineSystem
properties.definition: The system of medicine that includes this MedicalEntity, for example 'evidence-based', 'homeopathic', 'chiropractic', etc.

properties.label: meetsEmissionStandard
properties.definition: Indicates that the vehicle meets the respective emission standard.

properties.label: member
properties.definition: A member of an Organization or a ProgramMembership. Organizations can be members of organizations; ProgramMembership is typically for individuals.

properties.label: memberOf
properties.definition: An Organization (or ProgramMembership) to which this Person or Organization belongs.

properties.label: members
properties.definition: A member of this organization.

properties.label: membershipPointsEarned
properties.definition: The number of membership points earned by the member. If necessary, the unitText can be used to express the units the points are issued in. (E.g. stars, miles, etc.)

properties.label: mentions
properties.definition: Indicates that the CreativeWork contains a reference to, but is not necessarily about a concept.

properties.label: menu
properties.definition: Either the actual menu as a structured representation, as text, or a URL of the menu.

properties.label: menuAddOn
properties.definition: Additional menu item(s) such as a side dish of salad or side order of fries that can be added to this menu item. Additionally it can be a menu section containing allowed add-on menu items for this menu item.

properties.label: merchant
properties.definition: 'merchant' is an out-dated term for 'seller'.

properties.label: messageAttachment
properties.definition: A CreativeWork attached to the message.

properties.label: mileageFromOdometer
properties.definition: The total distance travelled by the particular vehicle since its initial production, as read from its odometer.\n\nTypical unit code(s): KMT for kilometers, SMI for statute miles.

properties.label: minimumPaymentDue
properties.definition: The minimum payment required at this time.

properties.label: missionCoveragePrioritiesPolicy
properties.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement on coverage priorities, including any public agenda or stance on issues.

properties.label: model
properties.definition: The model of the product. Use with the URL of a ProductModel or a textual representation of the model identifier. The URL of the ProductModel can be from an external source. It is recommended to additionally provide strong product identifiers via the gtin8/gtin13/gtin14 and mpn properties.

properties.label: molecularWeight
properties.definition: This is the molecular weight of the entity being described, not of the parent. Units should be included in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '12 amu' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

properties.label: monoisotopicMolecularWeight
properties.definition: The monoisotopic mass is the sum of the masses of the atoms in a molecule using the unbound, ground-state, rest mass of the principal (most abundant) isotope for each element instead of the isotopic average mass. Please include the units in the form '<Number> <unit>', for example '770.230488 g/mol' or as '<QuantitativeValue>.

properties.label: monthlyMinimumRepaymentAmount
properties.definition: The minimum payment is the lowest amount of money that one is required to pay on a credit card statement each month.

properties.label: musicArrangement
properties.definition: An arrangement derived from the composition.

properties.label: musicBy
properties.definition: The composer of the soundtrack.

properties.label: musicGroupMember
properties.definition: A member of a music group—for example, John, Paul, George, or Ringo.

properties.label: musicReleaseFormat
properties.definition: Format of this release (the type of recording media used, i.e. compact disc, digital media, LP, etc.).

properties.label: nationality
properties.definition: Nationality of the person.

properties.label: negativeNotes
properties.definition: Provides negative considerations regarding something, most typically in pro/con lists for reviews (alongside [[positiveNotes]]). For symmetry In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. Since product descriptions tend to emphasise positive claims, it may be relatively unusual to find [[negativeNotes]] used in this way. Nevertheless for the sake of symmetry, [[negativeNotes]] can be used on [[Product]]. The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most negative is at the beginning of the list).

properties.label: nerve
properties.definition: The underlying innervation associated with the muscle.

properties.label: nerveMotor
properties.definition: The neurological pathway extension that involves muscle control.

properties.label: netWorth
properties.definition: The total financial value of the person as calculated by subtracting the total value of liabilities from the total value of assets.

properties.label: newsUpdatesAndGuidelines
properties.definition: Indicates a page with news updates and guidelines. This could often be (but is not required to be) the main page containing [[SpecialAnnouncement]] markup on a site.

properties.label: nextItem
properties.definition: A link to the ListItem that follows the current one.

properties.label: noBylinesPolicy
properties.definition: For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other news-related [[Organization]], a statement explaining when authors of articles are not named in bylines.

properties.label: nonEqual
properties.definition: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is not equal to the object.

properties.label: nonprofitStatus
properties.definition: nonprofitStatus indicates the legal status of a non-profit organization in its primary place of business.

properties.label: normalRange
properties.definition: Range of acceptable values for a typical patient, when applicable.

properties.label: numAdults
properties.definition: The number of adults staying in the unit.

properties.label: numChildren
properties.definition: The number of children staying in the unit.

properties.label: numItems
properties.definition: Limits the number of items being shipped for which these conditions apply.

properties.label: numberOfAccommodationUnits
properties.definition: Indicates the total (available plus unavailable) number of accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits]].

properties.label: numberOfAvailableAccommodationUnits
properties.definition: Indicates the number of available accommodation units in an [[ApartmentComplex]], or the number of accommodation units for a specific [[FloorPlan]] (within its specific [[ApartmentComplex]]). See also [[numberOfAccommodationUnits]].

properties.label: numberOfAxles
properties.definition: The number of axles.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

properties.label: numberOfBedrooms
properties.definition: The total integer number of bedrooms in a some [[Accommodation]], [[ApartmentComplex]] or [[FloorPlan]].

properties.label: numberOfCredits
properties.definition: The number of credits or units awarded by a Course or required to complete an EducationalOccupationalProgram.

properties.label: numberOfDoors
properties.definition: The number of doors.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

properties.label: numberOfEmployees
properties.definition: The number of employees in an organization, e.g. business.

properties.label: numberOfForwardGears
properties.definition: The total number of forward gears available for the transmission system of the vehicle.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

properties.label: numberOfPlayers
properties.definition: Indicate how many people can play this game (minimum, maximum, or range).

properties.label: numberOfPreviousOwners
properties.definition: The number of owners of the vehicle, including the current one.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62.

properties.label: numberOfRooms
properties.definition: The number of rooms (excluding bathrooms and closets) of the accommodation or lodging business. Typical unit code(s): ROM for room or C62 for no unit. The type of room can be put in the unitText property of the QuantitativeValue.

properties.label: nutrition
properties.definition: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.

properties.label: object
properties.definition: The object upon which the action is carried out, whose state is kept intact or changed. Also known as the semantic roles patient, affected or undergoer (which change their state) or theme (which doesn't). E.g. John read *a book*.

properties.label: observationAbout
properties.definition: The [[observationAbout]] property identifies an entity, often a [[Place]], associated with an [[Observation]].

properties.label: occupancy
properties.definition: The allowed total occupancy for the accommodation in persons (including infants etc). For individual accommodations, this is not necessarily the legal maximum but defines the permitted usage as per the contractual agreement (e.g. a double room used by a single person). Typical unit code(s): C62 for person.

properties.label: occupationLocation
properties.definition: The region/country for which this occupational description is appropriate. Note that educational requirements and qualifications can vary between jurisdictions.

properties.label: occupationalCategory
properties.definition: A category describing the job, preferably using a term from a taxonomy such as [BLS O*NET-SOC](http://www.onetcenter.org/taxonomy.html), [ISCO-08](https://www.ilo.org/public/english/bureau/stat/isco/isco08/) or similar, with the property repeated for each applicable value. Ideally the taxonomy should be identified, and both the textual label and formal code for the category should be provided.\n Note: for historical reasons, any textual label and formal code provided as a literal may be assumed to be from O*NET-SOC.

properties.label: occupationalCredentialAwarded
properties.definition: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other occupational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

properties.label: offeredBy
properties.definition: A pointer to the organization or person making the offer.

properties.label: offers
properties.definition: An offer to provide this item—for example, an offer to sell a product, rent the DVD of a movie, perform a service, or give away tickets to an event. Use [[businessFunction]] to indicate the kind of transaction offered, i.e. sell, lease, etc. This property can also be used to describe a [[Demand]]. While this property is listed as expected on a number of common types, it can be used in others. In that case, using a second type, such as Product or a subtype of Product, can clarify the nature of the offer.

properties.label: openingHoursSpecification
properties.definition: The opening hours of a certain place.

properties.label: operatingSystem
properties.definition: Operating systems supported (Windows 7, OS X 10.6, Android 1.6).

properties.label: opponent
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The opponent on this action.

properties.label: option
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The options subject to this action.

properties.label: orderDelivery
properties.definition: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.

properties.label: orderItemStatus
properties.definition: The current status of the order item.

properties.label: orderQuantity
properties.definition: The number of the item ordered. If the property is not set, assume the quantity is one.

properties.label: orderStatus
properties.definition: The current status of the order.

properties.label: orderValue
properties.definition: Minimum and maximum order value for which these shipping conditions are valid.

properties.label: orderedItem
properties.definition: The item ordered.

properties.label: organizer
properties.definition: An organizer of an Event.

properties.label: originAddress
properties.definition: Shipper's address.

properties.label: originalMediaLink
properties.definition: Link to the page containing an original version of the content, or directly to an online copy of the original [[MediaObject]] content, e.g. video file.

properties.label: originatesFrom
properties.definition: The vasculature the lymphatic structure originates, or afferents, from.

properties.label: owner
properties.definition: A person or organization who owns this Thing.

properties.label: ownershipFundingInfo
properties.definition: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a description of organizational ownership structure; funding and grants. In a news/media setting, this is with particular reference to editorial independence. Note that the [[funder]] is also available and can be used to make basic funder information machine-readable.

properties.label: owns
properties.definition: Things owned by the organization or person.

properties.label: parent
properties.definition: A parent of this person.

properties.label: parentItem
properties.definition: The parent of a question, answer or item in general. Typically used for Q/A discussion threads e.g. a chain of comments with the first comment being an [[Article]] or other [[CreativeWork]]. See also [[comment]] which points from something to a comment about it.

properties.label: parentOrganization
properties.definition: The larger organization that this organization is a [[subOrganization]] of, if any.

properties.label: parentService
properties.definition: A broadcast service to which the broadcast service may belong to such as regional variations of a national channel.

properties.label: parentTaxon
properties.definition: Closest parent taxon of the taxon in question.

properties.label: parents
properties.definition: A parents of the person.

properties.label: partOfEpisode
properties.definition: The episode to which this clip belongs.

properties.label: partOfInvoice
properties.definition: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.

properties.label: partOfOrder
properties.definition: The overall order the items in this delivery were included in.

properties.label: partOfSeason
properties.definition: The season to which this episode belongs.

properties.label: partOfSeries
properties.definition: The series to which this episode or season belongs.

properties.label: partOfSystem
properties.definition: The anatomical or organ system that this structure is part of.

properties.label: partOfTVSeries
properties.definition: The TV series to which this episode or season belongs.

properties.label: partOfTrip
properties.definition: Identifies that this [[Trip]] is a subTrip of another Trip. For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

properties.label: participant
properties.definition: Other co-agents that participated in the action indirectly. E.g. John wrote a book with *Steve*.

properties.label: partySize
properties.definition: Number of people the reservation should accommodate.

properties.label: passengerPriorityStatus
properties.definition: The priority status assigned to a passenger for security or boarding (e.g. FastTrack or Priority).

properties.label: pattern
properties.definition: A pattern that something has, for example 'polka dot', 'striped', 'Canadian flag'. Values are typically expressed as text, although links to controlled value schemes are also supported.

properties.label: payload
properties.definition:
The permitted weight of passengers and cargo, EXCLUDING the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: Many databases specify the permitted TOTAL weight instead, which is the sum of [[weight]] and [[payload]]
* Note 2: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 3: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 4: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

properties.label: paymentMethod
properties.definition: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

properties.label: paymentMethodType
properties.definition: The type of a payment method.

properties.label: paymentStatus
properties.definition: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

properties.label: penciler
properties.definition: The individual who draws the primary narrative artwork.

properties.label: performTime
properties.definition: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

properties.label: performer
properties.definition: A performer at the event—for example, a presenter, musician, musical group or actor.

properties.label: performerIn
properties.definition: Event that this person is a performer or participant in.

properties.label: performers
properties.definition: The main performer or performers of the event—for example, a presenter, musician, or actor.

properties.label: permissionType
properties.definition: The type of permission granted the person, organization, or audience.

properties.label: permitAudience
properties.definition: The target audience for this permit.

properties.label: photo
properties.definition: A photograph of this place.

properties.label: photos
properties.definition: Photographs of this place.

properties.label: physicalRequirement
properties.definition: A description of the types of physical activity associated with the job. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

properties.label: pickupLocation
properties.definition: Where a taxi will pick up a passenger or a rental car can be picked up.

properties.label: playMode
properties.definition: Indicates whether this game is multi-player, co-op or single-player. The game can be marked as multi-player, co-op and single-player at the same time.

properties.label: populationType
properties.definition: Indicates the populationType common to all members of a [[StatisticalPopulation]] or all cases within the scope of a [[StatisticalVariable]].

properties.label: positiveNotes
properties.definition: Provides positive considerations regarding something, for example product highlights or (alongside [[negativeNotes]]) pro/con lists for reviews. In the case of a [[Review]], the property describes the [[itemReviewed]] from the perspective of the review; in the case of a [[Product]], the product itself is being described. The property values can be expressed either as unstructured text (repeated as necessary), or if ordered, as a list (in which case the most positive is at the beginning of the list).

properties.label: possibleTreatment
properties.definition: A possible treatment to address this condition, sign or symptom.

properties.label: postalCodeRange
properties.definition: A defined range of postal codes.

properties.label: potentialAction
properties.definition: Indicates a potential Action, which describes an idealized action in which this thing would play an 'object' role.

properties.label: potentialUse
properties.definition: Intended use of the BioChemEntity by humans.

properties.label: practicesAt
properties.definition: A [[MedicalOrganization]] where the [[IndividualPhysician]] practices.

properties.label: predecessorOf
properties.definition: A pointer from a previous, often discontinued variant of the product to its newer variant.

properties.label: pregnancyCategory
properties.definition: Pregnancy category of this drug.

properties.label: prepTime
properties.definition: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

properties.label: preparation
properties.definition: Typical preparation that a patient must undergo before having the procedure performed.

properties.label: prescriptionStatus
properties.definition: Indicates the status of drug prescription, e.g. local catalogs classifications or whether the drug is available by prescription or over-the-counter, etc.

properties.label: previousItem
properties.definition: A link to the ListItem that precedes the current one.

properties.label: priceComponent
properties.definition: This property links to all [[UnitPriceSpecification]] nodes that apply in parallel for the [[CompoundPriceSpecification]] node.

properties.label: priceComponentType
properties.definition: Identifies a price component (for example, a line item on an invoice), part of the total price for an offer.

properties.label: priceSpecification
properties.definition: One or more detailed price specifications, indicating the unit price and delivery or payment charges.

properties.label: priceType
properties.definition: Defines the type of a price specified for an offered product, for example a list price, a (temporary) sale price or a manufacturer suggested retail price. If multiple prices are specified for an offer the [[priceType]] property can be used to identify the type of each such specified price. The value of priceType can be specified as a value from enumeration PriceTypeEnumeration or, a UN/EDIFACT 5387 code, or as a free form text string for price types that are not already predefined in PriceTypeEnumeration.

properties.label: primaryImageOfPage
properties.definition: Indicates the main image on the page.

properties.label: primaryPrevention
properties.definition: A preventative therapy used to prevent an initial occurrence of the medical condition, such as vaccination.

properties.label: procedureType
properties.definition: The type of procedure, for example Surgical, Noninvasive, or Percutaneous.

properties.label: processingTime
properties.definition: Estimated processing time for the service using this channel.

properties.label: producer
properties.definition: The person or organization who produced the work (e.g. music album, movie, TV/radio series etc.).

properties.label: produces
properties.definition: The tangible thing generated by the service, e.g. a passport, permit, etc.

properties.label: productSupported
properties.definition: The product or service this support contact point is related to (such as product support for a particular product line). This can be a specific product or product line (e.g. "iPhone") or a general category of products or services (e.g. "smartphones").

properties.label: productionCompany
properties.definition: The production company or studio responsible for the item, e.g. series, video game, episode etc.

properties.label: program
properties.definition: The [MemberProgram](https://schema.org/MemberProgram) associated with a [ProgramMembership](https://schema.org/ProgramMembership).

properties.label: programMembershipUsed
properties.definition: Any membership in a frequent flyer, hotel loyalty program, etc. being applied to the reservation.

properties.label: programPrerequisites
properties.definition: Prerequisites for enrolling in the program.

properties.label: programType
properties.definition: The type of educational or occupational program. For example, classroom, internship, alternance, etc.

properties.label: programmingLanguage
properties.definition: The computer programming language.

properties.label: pronouns
properties.definition: A short string listing or describing pronouns for a person. Typically the person concerned is the best authority as pronouns are a critical part of personal identity and expression. Publishers and consumers of this information are reminded to treat this data responsibly, take country-specific laws related to gender expression into account, and be wary of out-of-date data and drawing unwarranted inferences about the person being described. In English, formulations such as "they/them", "she/her", and "he/him" are commonly used online and can also be used here. We do not intend to enumerate all possible micro-syntaxes in all languages. More structured and well-defined external values for pronouns can be referenced using the [[StructuredValue]] or [[DefinedTerm]] values.

properties.label: proteinContent
properties.definition: The number of grams of protein.

properties.label: provider
properties.definition: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

properties.label: providesBroadcastService
properties.definition: The BroadcastService offered on this channel.

properties.label: providesService
properties.definition: The service provided by this channel.

properties.label: publicTransportClosuresInfo
properties.definition: Information about public transport closures.

properties.label: publication
properties.definition: A publication event associated with the item.

properties.label: publishedBy
properties.definition: An agent associated with the publication event.

properties.label: publishedOn
properties.definition: A broadcast service associated with the publication event.

properties.label: publisher
properties.definition: The publisher of the article in question.

properties.label: publisherImprint
properties.definition: The publishing division which published the comic.

properties.label: publishingPrinciples
properties.definition: The publishingPrinciples property indicates (typically via [[URL]]) a document describing the editorial principles of an [[Organization]] (or individual, e.g. a [[Person]] writing a blog) that relate to their activities as a publisher, e.g. ethics or diversity policies. When applied to a [[CreativeWork]] (e.g. [[NewsArticle]]) the principles are those of the party primarily responsible for the creation of the [[CreativeWork]]. While such policies are most typically expressed in natural language, sometimes related information (e.g. indicating a [[funder]]) can be expressed using schema.org terminology.

properties.label: purchasePriceLimit
properties.definition: Optional. The maximum price the item can have and still qualify for this offer.

properties.label: purchaseType
properties.definition: Optional. The type of purchase the consumer must make in order to qualify for this incentive.

properties.label: qualifications
properties.definition: Specific qualifications required for this role or Occupation.

properties.label: qualifiedExpense
properties.definition: Optional. The types of expenses that are covered by the incentive. For example some incentives are only for the goods (tangible items) but the services (labor) are excluded.

properties.label: quarantineGuidelines
properties.definition: Guidelines about quarantine rules, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

properties.label: quest
properties.definition: The task that a player-controlled character, or group of characters may complete in order to gain a reward.

properties.label: question
properties.definition: A sub property of object. A question.

properties.label: rangeIncludes
properties.definition: Relates a property to a class that constitutes (one of) the expected type(s) for values of the property.

properties.label: readBy
properties.definition: A person who reads (performs) the audiobook.

properties.label: realEstateAgent
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The real estate agent involved in the action.

properties.label: recipe
properties.definition: A sub property of instrument. The recipe/instructions used to perform the action.

properties.label: recipeIngredient
properties.definition: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic. The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

properties.label: recipeInstructions
properties.definition: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

properties.label: recipeYield
properties.definition: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).

properties.label: recipient
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the receiving end of the action.

properties.label: recognizedBy
properties.definition: An organization that acknowledges the validity, value or utility of a credential. Note: recognition may include a process of quality assurance or accreditation.

properties.label: recognizingAuthority
properties.definition: If applicable, the organization that officially recognizes this entity as part of its endorsed system of medicine.

properties.label: recommendedIntake
properties.definition: Recommended intake of this supplement for a given population as defined by a specific recommending authority.

properties.label: recordLabel
properties.definition: The label that issued the release.

properties.label: recordedAs
properties.definition: An audio recording of the work.

properties.label: recordedAt
properties.definition: The Event where the CreativeWork was recorded. The CreativeWork may capture all or part of the event.

properties.label: recordedIn
properties.definition: The CreativeWork that captured all or part of this Event.

properties.label: recordingOf
properties.definition: The composition this track is a recording of.

properties.label: referee
properties.definition: An official who watches a game or match closely to enforce the rules and arbitrate on matters arising from the play such as referees, umpires or judges. The name of the effective function can vary according to the sport.

properties.label: referenceQuantity
properties.definition: The reference quantity for which a certain price applies, e.g. 1 EUR per 4 kWh of electricity. This property is a replacement for unitOfMeasurement for the advanced cases where the price does not relate to a standard unit.

properties.label: referencesOrder
properties.definition: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

properties.label: refundType
properties.definition: A refund type, from an enumerated list.

properties.label: regionDrained
properties.definition: The anatomical or organ system drained by this vessel; generally refers to a specific part of an organ.

properties.label: regionsAllowed
properties.definition: The regions where the media is allowed. If not specified, then it's assumed to be allowed everywhere. Specify the countries in [ISO 3166 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166).

properties.label: relatedAnatomy
properties.definition: Anatomical systems or structures that relate to the superficial anatomy.

properties.label: relatedCondition
properties.definition: A medical condition associated with this anatomy.

properties.label: relatedDrug
properties.definition: Any other drug related to this one, for example commonly-prescribed alternatives.

properties.label: relatedStructure
properties.definition: Related anatomical structure(s) that are not part of the system but relate or connect to it, such as vascular bundles associated with an organ system.

properties.label: relatedTherapy
properties.definition: A medical therapy related to this anatomy.

properties.label: relatedTo
properties.definition: The most generic familial relation.

properties.label: releaseOf
properties.definition: The album this is a release of.

properties.label: releasedEvent
properties.definition: The place and time the release was issued, expressed as a PublicationEvent.

properties.label: relevantOccupation
properties.definition: The Occupation for the JobPosting.

properties.label: relevantSpecialty
properties.definition: If applicable, a medical specialty in which this entity is relevant.

properties.label: repeatFrequency
properties.definition: Defines the frequency at which [[Event]]s will occur according to a schedule [[Schedule]]. The intervals between events should be defined as a [[Duration]] of time.

properties.label: repetitions
properties.definition: Number of times one should repeat the activity.

properties.label: replacee
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The object that is being replaced.

properties.label: replacer
properties.definition: A sub property of object. The object that replaces.

properties.label: requiredCollateral
properties.definition: Assets required to secure loan or credit repayments. It may take form of third party pledge, goods, financial instruments (cash, securities, etc.)

properties.label: requiredQuantity
properties.definition: The required quantity of the item(s).

properties.label: requiresSubscription
properties.definition: Indicates if use of the media require a subscription (either paid or free). Allowed values are ```true``` or ```false``` (note that an earlier version had 'yes', 'no').

properties.label: reservationFor
properties.definition: The thing -- flight, event, restaurant, etc. being reserved.

properties.label: reservationStatus
properties.definition: The current status of the reservation.

properties.label: reservedTicket
properties.definition: A ticket associated with the reservation.

properties.label: restPeriods
properties.definition: How often one should break from the activity.

properties.label: restockingFee
properties.definition: Use [[MonetaryAmount]] to specify a fixed restocking fee for product returns, or use [[Number]] to specify a percentage of the product price paid by the customer.

properties.label: result
properties.definition: The result produced in the action. E.g. John wrote *a book*.

properties.label: resultComment
properties.definition: A sub property of result. The Comment created or sent as a result of this action.

properties.label: resultReview
properties.definition: A sub property of result. The review that resulted in the performing of the action.

properties.label: returnFees
properties.definition: The type of return fees for purchased products (for any return reason).

properties.label: returnLabelSource
properties.definition: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned for any reason.

properties.label: returnMethod
properties.definition: The type of return method offered, specified from an enumeration.

properties.label: returnPolicyCategory
properties.definition: Specifies an applicable return policy (from an enumeration).

properties.label: returnPolicyCountry
properties.definition: The country where the product has to be sent to for returns, for example "Ireland" using the [[name]] property of [[Country]]. You can also provide the two-letter [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1). Note that this can be different from the country where the product was originally shipped from or sent to.

properties.label: returnPolicySeasonalOverride
properties.definition: Seasonal override of a return policy.

properties.label: returnShippingFeesAmount
properties.definition: Amount of shipping costs for product returns (for any reason). Applicable when property [[returnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

properties.label: review
properties.definition: A review of the item.

properties.label: reviewAspect
properties.definition: This Review or Rating is relevant to this part or facet of the itemReviewed.

properties.label: reviewRating
properties.definition: The rating given in this review. Note that reviews can themselves be rated. The ```reviewRating``` applies to rating given by the review. The [[aggregateRating]] property applies to the review itself, as a creative work.

properties.label: reviewedBy
properties.definition: People or organizations that have reviewed the content on this web page for accuracy and/or completeness.

properties.label: reviews
properties.definition: Review of the item.

properties.label: riskFactor
properties.definition: A modifiable or non-modifiable factor that increases the risk of a patient contracting this condition, e.g. age, coexisting condition.

properties.label: roofLoad
properties.definition:
The permitted total weight of cargo and installations (e.g. a roof rack) on top of the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]]
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

properties.label: rsvpResponse
properties.definition: The response (yes, no, maybe) to the RSVP.

properties.label: runsTo
properties.definition: The vasculature the lymphatic structure runs, or efferents, to.

properties.label: runtimePlatform
properties.definition: Runtime platform or script interpreter dependencies (example: Java v1, Python 2.3, .NET Framework 3.0).

properties.label: salaryUponCompletion
properties.definition: The expected salary upon completing the training.

properties.label: saturatedFatContent
properties.definition: The number of grams of saturated fat.

properties.label: schoolClosuresInfo
properties.definition: Information about school closures.

properties.label: screenshot
properties.definition: A link to a screenshot image of the app.

properties.label: sdLicense
properties.definition: A license document that applies to this structured data, typically indicated by URL.

properties.label: sdPublisher
properties.definition: Indicates the party responsible for generating and publishing the current structured data markup, typically in cases where the structured data is derived automatically from existing published content but published on a different site. For example, student projects and open data initiatives often re-publish existing content with more explicitly structured metadata. The [[sdPublisher]] property helps make such practices more explicit.

properties.label: season
properties.definition: A season in a media series.

properties.label: seasonalOverride
properties.definition: Limited period during which these shipping conditions apply.

properties.label: seasons
properties.definition: A season in a media series.

properties.label: seatingCapacity
properties.definition: The number of persons that can be seated (e.g. in a vehicle), both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

properties.label: seatingType
properties.definition: The type/class of the seat.

properties.label: secondaryPrevention
properties.definition: A preventative therapy used to prevent reoccurrence of the medical condition after an initial episode of the condition.

properties.label: seeks
properties.definition: A pointer to products or services sought by the organization or person (demand).

properties.label: seller
properties.definition: An entity which offers (sells / leases / lends / loans) the services / goods. A seller may also be a provider.

properties.label: sender
properties.definition: A sub property of participant. The participant who is at the sending end of the action.

properties.label: sensoryRequirement
properties.definition: A description of any sensory requirements and levels necessary to function on the job, including hearing and vision. Defined terms such as those in O*net may be used, but note that there is no way to specify the level of ability as well as its nature when using a defined term.

properties.label: sensoryUnit
properties.definition: The neurological pathway extension that inputs and sends information to the brain or spinal cord.

properties.label: seriousAdverseOutcome
properties.definition: A possible serious complication and/or serious side effect of this therapy.
